	end

		e5.CAP.drawing = false
		return e5.DRAW_STUB

			e5.CAP.drawing = false

				e1e:Remove()

		end

end

		if not isfolder("ECLIPSE_Configs") then

			"ECLIPSE_Configs/left-" .. e3.Name .. ".json",

		)

		e5.rjFinished = true

			local e68 = e5.rejoinRead()
			e68.farms, e68.pending = {}, nil

		end)
	end
end

	local function e6d(e6e)
		return e6e ~= nil and e6b[e6e] and not e6c[e6e]
	end
	local e6f = e6a.nextMap
	if not e6d(e6f) then
		e6f = e6a.map
	end
	if not e6d(e6f) then
		e6f = e6a.lastMap
	end
	if not e6d(e6f) then
		e6f = nil
		for e70, e71 in ipairs(e5.MAP_ORDER) do
			if e6d(e71) then
				e6f = e71
				break
			end
		end
		if not e6f then
			for e72 in pairs(e6b) do
				if e6d(e72) then
					e6f = e72
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not e6b[e6f] then
		e6f = e6a.map
	end
	if not e6b[e6f] then
		e6f = e6a.lastMap
	end
	if not e6b[e6f] then
		e6f = e6b.Jurassic and "Jurassic" or next(e6b)
	end
	return e6f
end

		end

			return e90.n > e91.n
		end)
		local e92 = e8a[math.random(1, math.max(1, math.min(3, #e8a)))]
		e73.pending = os.time()
		e5.rejoinWrite(e73)
		local e93, e94

			end

	end

		e7b("gave up")
	end

function e5.resolveRoot(ea8, ea9)
	if not ea8 then
		return nil
	end
	local eaa = ea8:FindFirstChild("Body")
	local eab = ea8:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local eac, ead
	if ea9 then
		eac, ead = eab, eaa
	else
		eac, ead = eaa, eab
	end
	if eac and eac:IsA("BasePart") then
		return eac
	end
	if ead and ead:IsA("BasePart") then
		return ead
	end
	local eae = ea8.PrimaryPart
	if eae and eae:IsA("BasePart") then
		return eae
	end
	local eaf = ea8:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
	if eaf then
		local eb0 = eaf:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if eb0 and eb0:IsA("BasePart") then
			return eb0
		end
	end
	for eb1, eb2 in ea8:GetChildren() do
		if eb2:IsA("BasePart") and eb2.Name ~= "MouthPart" and eb2.Name ~= "HitBox" and eb2.Name ~= "CameraPart" then
			return eb2
		end
	end
	local eb3 = ea8:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
	if eb3 and eb3:IsA("BasePart") then
		return eb3
	end
	for eb4, eb5 in ea8:GetDescendants() do
		if eb5:IsA("BasePart") and eb5.Name ~= "MouthPart" and eb5.Name ~= "CameraPart" then
			return eb5
		end
	end
	return nil
end
function e5.getRootOf(eb6, eb7)
	if not eb6 then
		return nil
	end
	local eb8 = eb7 and e5.rootCachePhysics or e5.rootCacheVisual
	local eb9 = eb8[eb6]
	if eb9 and eb9.Parent then
		return eb9
	end
	local eba = e5.resolveRoot(eb6, eb7)
	eb8[eb6] = eba
	return eba
end
function e5.getLocalRoot()
	return e5.getRootOf(e3.Character, false)
end
function e5.getLocalPhysicsRoot()
	return e5.getRootOf(e3.Character, true)
end

function e5.setAllHitboxMultipliers(ec8)
	ec8 = math.clamp(tonumber(ec8) or (-8596 + 8597), 1, 10)
	e5.HITBOX_MULTIPLIER = ec8
	for ec9, eca in ipairs(e5.PART_GROUP_ORDER) do
		e5.HITBOX_MULTIPLIERS[eca] = ec8
		local ecb = e5.hitboxMultiplierControls and e5.hitboxMultiplierControls[eca]
		if ecb and ecb.Set then
			pcall(function()
				ecb:Set(ec8, true)
			end)
		end
	end
end
function e5.hitboxMultiplierFor(ecc)
	return math.clamp(tonumber(e5.HITBOX_MULTIPLIERS[ecc]) or tonumber(e5.HITBOX_MULTIPLIER) or (-2600 + 2601), 1, 10)
end
function e5.addHitboxMultiplierControls(ecd)
	e5.hitboxMultiplierControls = {}
	for ece, ecf in ipairs(e5.PART_GROUP_ORDER) do
		local ed0 = ecf
		local ed1 = ecd:AddSlider({
			Name = (e5.GROUP_LABELS[ed0] or ed0) .. " Multiplier",
			Min = 1,
			Max = 10,
			Default = e5.hitboxMultiplierFor(ed0),
			Callback = function(ed2)
				e5.HITBOX_MULTIPLIERS[ed0] = math.clamp(tonumber(ed2) or (-9395 + 9396), 1, 10)
				if e5.markScaled then
					e5.markScaled(e5.hitboxToggle, e5.hitboxMultiplierControls[ed0], ed2)
				end
			end,
		})
		e5.hitboxMultiplierControls[ed0] = ed1
	end
end
function e5.groupDropdown(ed3, ed4, ed5, ed6, ed7)
	local ed8, ed9, eda = {}, {}, {}
	for edb, edc in ipairs(ed6) do
		local edd = e5.GROUP_LABELS[edc] or edc
		ed8[edd] = edc
		ed9[#ed9 + 1] = edd
		if ed5[edc] then
			eda[#eda + 1] = edd
		end
	end
	local ede = ed3:AddDropdown({
		Name = ed4,
		Items = ed9,
		Multi = true,
		Default = eda,
		Callback = function(edf)
			for ee0, ee1 in ipairs(ed6) do
				ed5[ee1] = false
			end
			if type(edf) == "table" then
				for ee2, ee3 in pairs(edf) do
					local ee4 = ed8[ee2]
					if ee3 and ee4 then
						ed5[ee4] = true
					end
				end
			end
			if ed7 then
				ed7()
			end
		end,
	})
	ede.Refill = function()
		local ee5 = {}
		for ee6, ee7 in ipairs(ed6) do
			if ed5[ee7] then
				ee5[e5.GROUP_LABELS[ee7] or ee7] = true
			end
		end
		ede:Set(ee5, true)
	end
	return ede
end
function e5.getTailSubGroup(ee8)
	local ee9 = ee8:lower()
	if ee9:find("thagomizer") then
		return "Thagomizer"
	end
	local eea = tonumber(ee8:match("Tail%.(%d+)"))
	if not eea then
		return "TailBase"
	end
	if eea <= 4 then
		return "TailBase"
	elseif eea <= 9 then
		return "TailMid"
	else
		return "TailTip"
	end
end

function e5.createESP(eed)
	if eed == e3 then
		return
	end
	if e5.espCache[eed] then
		return
	end
	local eee = { billboard = nil, highlight = nil, connections = {}, tracer = nil }
	e5.espCache[eed] = eee
end
function e5.destroyESP(eef)
	local ef0 = e5.espCache[eef]
	if not ef0 then
		return
	end
	if ef0.billboard then
		pcall(function()
			ef0.billboard:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	if ef0.highlight then
		pcall(function()
			ef0.highlight:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	if ef0.tracer then
		pcall(function()
			ef0.tracer:Remove()
		end)
	end
	for ef1, ef2 in pairs(ef0.connections) do
		pcall(function()
			ef2:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	e5.espCache[eef] = nil
end
function e5.hidePlayerESP(ef3)
	if ef3.billboard then
		ef3.billboard.Enabled = false
	end
	if ef3.highlight then
		ef3.highlight:Destroy()
		ef3.highlight = nil
	end
	if ef3.tracer then
		pcall(function()
			ef3.tracer.Visible = false
		end)
	end
end
function e5.updateESP(ef4)
	local ef5 = e5.espCache[ef4]
	if not ef5 then
		return
	end
	local ef6 = ef4.Character
	if ef5.character ~= ef6 then
		e5.destroyESP(ef4)
		e5.createESP(ef4)
		ef5 = e5.espCache[ef4]
		ef5.character = ef6
	end
	if not ef6 or not ef6.Parent then
		e5.hidePlayerESP(ef5)
		return
	end
	                                                                      
	local ef7 = ef6:GetAttribute("Health")
	if type(ef7) ~= "number" then
		local ef8 = ef6:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
		ef7 = ef8 and ef8.Health or nil
	end
	if type(ef7) == "number" and ef7 <= 0 then
		e5.hidePlayerESP(ef5)
		return
	end
	local ef9 = e5.getRootOf(ef6, false)
	if not ef9 or not ef9:IsDescendantOf(ef6) then
		ef9 = ef6.PrimaryPart or ef6:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end
	if not ef9 then
		e5.hidePlayerESP(ef5)
		return
	end
	local efa = e5.getLocalRoot()
	local efb = efa and (efa.Position - ef9.Position).Magnitude or 0
	if efb > e5.ESP_DISTANCE then
		e5.hidePlayerESP(ef5)
		return
	end

	                                                                       
	if e5.CHAMS_ENABLED then
		local efc = ef5.highlight
		if efc and (not efc.Parent or efc.Adornee ~= ef6 or efc.Parent ~= ef6) then
			efc:Destroy()
			efc = nil
			ef5.highlight = nil
		end
		if not efc then
			efc = Instance.new("Highlight")
			efc.Name = "DinoChams"
			efc.Adornee = ef6
			efc.Parent = ef6
			ef5.highlight = efc
		end
		efc.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		efc.FillColor = e5.ESP_COLOR
		efc.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		efc.FillTransparency = e5.CHAMS_FILL_TRANSPARENCY
		efc.OutlineTransparency = e5.CHAMS_OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY
		efc.Enabled = true
	elseif ef5.highlight then
		ef5.highlight:Destroy()
		ef5.highlight = nil
	end
	                                                                      
	ef7 = ef7 or 0

	if e5.ESP_ENABLED then
		if ef5.billboard and ef5.billboard.Parent ~= ef9 then
			pcall(function()
				ef5.billboard.Adornee = ef9
				ef5.billboard.Parent = ef9
			end)
		end
		if not ef5.billboard or not ef5.billboard.Parent then
			local efd = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			efd.Name = "DinoESP"
			efd.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 122)
			efd.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
			efd.AlwaysOnTop = true
			efd.LightInfluence = 0
			efd.MaxDistance = e5.ESP_DISTANCE
			local efe = Instance.new("Frame")
			efe.Name = "Container"
			efe.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			efe.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			efe.Parent = efd
			local eff = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
			eff.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
			eff.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
			eff.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
			eff.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
			eff.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
			eff.Parent = efe
			local function e100(e101, e102, e103, e104, e105)
				local e106 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				e106.Name = e101
				e106.LayoutOrder = e102
				e106.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, e103 + 3)
				e106.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				e106.TextColor3 = e105
				e106.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
				e106.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				e106.Font = e104
				e106.TextSize = e103
				e106.TextScaled = false
				e106.Parent = efe
				return e106
			end
			local function e107(e108, e109, e10a)
				local e10b = Instance.new("Frame")
				e10b.Name = e108
				e10b.LayoutOrder = e109
				e10b.Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 15)
				e10b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
				e10b.BorderSizePixel = 0
				e10b.Parent = efe
				Instance.new("UICorner", e10b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
				local e10c = Instance.new("Frame")
				e10c.Name = "Fill"
				e10c.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
				e10c.BackgroundColor3 = e10a

e5.espErrors = {}
function e5.safeUpdateESP(e14f)
	local e150, e151 = pcall(e5.updateESP, e14f)
	if e150 then
		e5.espErrors[e14f] = nil
		return
	end
	local e152 = os.clock()
	local e153 = e5.espErrors[e14f]
	if not e153 or e152 - e153.time >= 15 then
		warn("[ECLIPSE ESP] " .. e14f.Name .. ": " .. tostring(e151))
		e5.espErrors[e14f] = { time = e152, message = tostring(e151) }
	end
end
e5.ESP_SLICE = 32
e5.espCursor = 0
e5.addStep(3, function()
	if not e5.ESP_ENABLED and not e5.CHAMS_ENABLED and not e5.TRACERS_ENABLED then
		return
	end
	local e154 = e1:GetPlayers()
	local e155 = #e154
	if e155 == 0 then
		return
	end
	if (e5.TRACERS_ENABLED and e5.CAP.drawing) or e155 <= (e5.ESP_SLICE or (9936 - 9904)) then
		for e156, e157 in e154 do
			if e157 == e3 then
				continue
			end
			if not e5.espCache[e157] then
				e5.createESP(e157)
			end
			e5.safeUpdateESP(e157)
		end
		return
	end
	local e158 = e5.espCursor or (-1049 + 1049)
	for e159 = 1, e5.ESP_SLICE do
		e158 = e158 % e155 + 1
		local e15a = e154[e158]
		if e15a and e15a ~= e3 and e15a.Parent then
			if not e5.espCache[e15a] then
				e5.createESP(e15a)
			end
			e5.safeUpdateESP(e15a)
		end
	end
	e5.espCursor = e158
end)

end
function e5.mmapFind()
	local e210 = e5.mmapCache
	if e210 then
		local e211, e212 = pcall(function()
			local e213 = rawget(e210, "TagsFrame")
			return e213 ~= nil and e213.Parent ~= nil
		end)
		if e211 and e212 then
			return e210
		end
		e5.mmapCache = nil
	end
	local e214 = os.clock()
	if e5.mmapNextScan and e214 < e5.mmapNextScan then
		return nil
	end
	e5.mmapNextScan = e214 + 3
	if not e5.CAP.filtergc then
		return nil
	end
	local e215
	local e216 = os.clock()
	pcall(function()
		e215 = filtergc("table", { Keys = { "TagsFrame", "Tags", "Viewport" } }, true)
	end)
	if e5.IS_XENO and os.clock() - e216 > 0.05 then
		e5.CAP.filtergc = false
	end
	e5.mmapCache = e215
	return e215
end

end

function e5.mmapEnsure(e21e, e21f)

	end
end
function e5.mmapCollect()
	local e224 = {}
	local e225 = e5.getLocalRoot()
	local e226 = e225 and e225.Position or Vector3.zero
	local function e227(e228, e229)
		e224[#e224 + 1] = { pos = e228, color = e229, d = (e228 - e226).Magnitude }
	end
	if e5.MMAP_PLAYERS then
		pcall(function()
			for e22a, e22b in ipairs(e1:GetPlayers()) do
				if e22b ~= e3 then
					local e22c = e22b.Character
					local e22d = e22c and e5.getRootOf(e22c, false)
					if e22d then
						e227(e22d.Position, e5.MMAP_COLOR_PLAYER)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if e5.MMAP_CORPSES then
		for e22e, e22f in ipairs(e5.MMAP_CORPSE_FOLDERS) do
			pcall(function()
				local e230 = e5.mmapFolder(e22f)
				if not e230 then
					return
				end
				for e231, e232 in ipairs(e230:GetChildren()) do
					local e233 = e5.worldESPAnchor(e232)
					if e233 then
						e227(e233.Position, e5.MMAP_COLOR_CORPSE)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	if e5.MMAP_FOSSILS then
		pcall(function()
			local e234 = workspace:FindFirstChild("SpawnedFossils")
			if not e234 then
				return
			end
			for e235, e236 in ipairs(e234:GetChildren()) do
				local e237 = e5.worldESPAnchor(e236)
				if e237 then
					e227(e237.Position, e5.MMAP_COLOR_FOSSIL)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if #e224 > e5.MMAP_MAX then
		table.sort(e224, function(e238, e239)
			return e238.d < e239.d
		end)
	end
	e5.mmapList = e224
end
function e5.mmapStep()
	if e5.UNLOADED then
		return
	end
	if not e5.MMAP_ON or not (e5.MMAP_PLAYERS or e5.MMAP_CORPSES or e5.MMAP_FOSSILS) then
		if e5.mmapShown > 0 then
			e5.mmapHideAll()
		end
		return
	end
	local e23a = e5.mmapFind()
	if not e23a then
		return
	end
	if e5.mmapBoundTo ~= e23a then
		e5.mmapPool = {}
		e5.mmapShown = 0
		e5.mmapBoundTo = e23a
	end
	e5.mmapTick = (e5.mmapTick or (577 - 577)) + 1
	if not e5.mmapList or e5.mmapTick % 5 == 1 then
		e5.mmapCollect()
	end
	local e23b = e5.mmapList
	if not e23b then
		return
	end
	local e23c = math.min(#e23b, e5.MMAP_MAX)
	e5.mmapEnsure(e23c, e23a)
	local e23d = rawget(e23a, "Mini")
	local e23e = rawget(e23a, "Expanded")
	local e23f = rawget(e23a, "Viewport")
	local e240 = e23d and e23d.Visible
	local e241 = e23e and e23e.Visible
	local e242 = 0
	pcall(function()
		if e23f then
			e242 = e23f.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.5
		end
	end)
	local e243, e244, e245
	pcall(function()
		e243 = e23a.GetTagPosition
		e244 = e23a.GetDistanceFromCenter
		e245 = e23a.TransformPosition
	end)
	for e246 = 1, e23c do
		local e247 = e23b[e246]
		local e248 = e5.mmapPool[e246]
		if e248 then
			if e248.mini then
				if e240 then
					local e249, e24a
					if e243 then
						e249, e24a = pcall(e243, e23a, e247.pos)
					end
					if e249 and e24a then
						e248.mini.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(e24a.X, e24a.Y)
						e248.mini.BackgroundColor3 = e247.color
						local e24b, e24c
						if e244 then
							e24b, e24c = pcall(e244, e23a, e24a)
						end
						e248.mini.Visible = (not e24b) or (e24c <= e242)
					else
						e248.mini.Visible = false
					end
				else
					e248.mini.Visible = false
				end
			end
			if e248.exp then
				if e241 then
					local e24d, e24e
					if e245 then
						e24d, e24e = pcall(e245, e23a, e247.pos)
					end
					if e24d and e24e then
						e248.exp.Position = e24e
						e248.exp.BackgroundColor3 = e247.color
						e248.exp.Visible = true
					else
						e248.exp.Visible = false
					end
				else
					e248.exp.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for e24f = e23c + 1, #e5.mmapPool do
		local e250 = e5.mmapPool[e24f]
		if e250.mini then
			e250.mini.Visible = false
		end
		if e250.exp then
			e250.exp.Visible = false
		end
	end
	e5.mmapShown = e23c
end
e5.addStep(3, e5.mmapStep)

function e5.expandPlayerHitbox(e265)
	local e266 = e265.Character
	if not e266 then
		return
	end
	local e267 = e266:GetAttribute("Health")
	if type(e267)=="number" and e267<=0 then e5.restoreNativeCharacter(e266); return end
	local e268 = e266:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
	if not e268 then
		return
	end
	for e269, e26a in e268:GetChildren() do
		if not e26a:IsA("BasePart") then
			continue
		end
		local e26b = e26a:GetAttribute("Group")
		if not e26b then
			continue
		end
		if e26a:GetAttribute("Link") then
			continue
		end
		e5.rememberNativeHitbox(e26a, e266)
		local e26c = (e26b == "Tail") and e5.getTailSubGroup(e26a.Name) or e26b
		if not ebb[e26a] then
			ebb[e26a] = e26a.Size
		end
		local e26d = ebb[e26a]
		pcall(function()
			if e5.HITBOX_EXPANDER and e5.HITBOX_GROUPS[e26c] then
				e26a.Size = e26d * e5.hitboxMultiplierFor(e26c)
			else
				e26a.Size = e26d
			end
		end)
		if not e5.IS_XENO then
			pcall(function()
				if e5.SILENT_AIM then
					e26a.CanQuery = e5.SILENT_GROUPS[e26c] and true or false
				else
					e26a.CanQuery = e5.nativeHitboxes[e26a].query
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end
function e5.resetPlayerHitbox(e26e)
	local e26f = e26e.Character
	if not e26f then
		return
	end
	local e270 = e26f:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
	if e270 then

					e272.Size = e273
					if e5.nativeHitboxes[e272] then e272.CanQuery = e5.nativeHitboxes[e272].query end
				end)

			end
		end
	end
	local e274 = e26f:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
	if e274 and ebb[e274] then
		pcall(function()
			e274.Size = ebb[e274]
		end)
		ebb[e274] = nil
	end
end
function e5.visualizePlayerHitbox(e275, e276)

			if not e27b:IsA("BasePart") then
				continue
			end
			if e276 then e5.rememberNativeHitbox(e27b, e277) end
			local e27c = e27b:GetAttribute("Group") or "ungrouped"
			local e27d = false
			if e27c == "Tail" then

				e27d = e5.HITBOX_GROUPS[e27e]

					e27b.Transparency = e5.HITBOX_VIS_TRANSPARENCY
					e27b.Color = e5.HITBOX_VIS_COLOR

					if e27f then
						e27b.Transparency, e27b.Material, e27b.Color = e27f[1], e27f[2], e27f[3]
						ebc[e27b] = nil
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local e280 = e277:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
	if e280 and e280:IsA("BasePart") then
		if e276 then e5.rememberNativeHitbox(e280, e277) end
		pcall(function()
			if e276 then
				if not ebc[e280] then
					ebc[e280] = { e280.Transparency, e280.Material, e280.Color }
				end
				e280.Transparency = e5.HITBOX_VIS_TRANSPARENCY
				e280.Color = e5.HITBOX_VIS_COLOR
				e280.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			else
				local e281 = ebc[e280]
				if e281 then
					e280.Transparency, e280.Material, e280.Color = e281[1], e281[2], e281[3]
					ebc[e280] = nil
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function e5.isBlackOverlay(e29c)
	if not e29c:IsA("Frame") and not e29c:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		return false
	end
	if e29c.BackgroundTransparency > 0.1 then
		return false
	end
	local e29d = e29c.BackgroundColor3
	if e29d.R > 0.05 or e29d.G > 0.05 or e29d.B > 0.05 then
		return false
	end
	local e29e = e29c.AbsoluteSize
	local e29f, e2a0 = e4.ViewportSize.X, e4.ViewportSize.Y
	if e29e.X < e29f * 0.8 or e29e.Y < e2a0 * 0.8 then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function e5.sweepGuiRoot(e2a9)
	for e2aa, e2ab in e2a9:GetChildren() do
		if not e2ab:IsA("ScreenGui") then
			continue
		end
		if e2ab.Name == "ECLIPSE" or e2ab.Name == "ECLIPSEIndicator" or e2ab.Name == "ScanNotify" then
			continue
		end
		for e2ac, e2ad in e2ab:GetDescendants() do
			if e5.isBlackOverlay(e2ad) then
				e2ad.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
		end
	end
end
function e5.neutralizeBlackScreens()
	local e2ae = os.clock()
	local e2af = (e2ae - e5.absLastFull) >= e5.ABS_FULL_INTERVAL
	if e5.absDirty or e2af then
		e5.absDirty = false
		if e2af then
			e5.absLastFull = e2ae
		end
		pcall(function()
			local e2b0 = e3:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
			if e2b0 then
				e5.sweepGuiRoot(e2b0)
			end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			e5.sweepGuiRoot(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
		end)
	end
	pcall(function()
		for e2b1, e2b2 in e29b:GetChildren() do
			if e2b2:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
				if e2b2.Brightness < -0.3 then
					e2b2.Brightness = 0
				end
				if e2b2.TintColor.R < 0.1 and e2b2.TintColor.G < 0.1 and e2b2.TintColor.B < 0.1 then
					e2b2.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		for e2b3, e2b4 in e4:GetChildren() do
			if e2b4:IsA("BasePart") then
				local e2b5 = e2b4.Color
				if e2b5 and e2b5.R < 0.05 and e2b5.G < 0.05 and e2b5.B < 0.05 and e2b4.Transparency ~= 1 then
					e2b4.Transparency = 1
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function e5.isNightHour(e2b8)
	return e2b8 >= 20 or e2b8 <= 5
end
function e5.timePresetFor(e2b9)
	if e5.isNightHour(e2b9) then
		return "Night"
	end
	if e2b9 < 8 then
		return "Sunrise"
	end
	if e2b9 >= 18 then
		return "Sunset"
	end
	return "Day"
end
function e5.refreshCustomTime()
	task.spawn(function()
		local e2ba = e5.getWeatherController()
		if not (e2ba and e5.customTime) then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			e2ba:ApplyLightingTransition(0, true)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			e2ba:ApplyRenderClockTime(e5.customTimeHour, e5.timePresetFor(e5.customTimeHour))
		end)
	end)
end
function e5.setCustomTime(e2bb)
	e5.customTime = e2bb
	task.spawn(e5.applyCustomTime, e2bb)
end
function e5.applyCustomTime(e2bc)
	local e2bd = e5.getWeatherController()
	if not e2bd then
		pcall(function()
			e5.Hub:Notify("Custom Time: weather controller unreachable \226\128\148 clock only, lighting unchanged", 6)
		end)
		return
	end
	if e2bc then
		if not e5.wcOrig then
			e5.wcOrig = {
				IsArtificialNight = e2bd.IsArtificialNight,
				GetSimulationClockTime = e2bd.GetSimulationClockTime,
				GetDesiredTransitionType = e2bd.GetDesiredTransitionType,
			}
		end
		e2bd.IsArtificialNight = function()
			return e5.isNightHour(e5.customTimeHour)
		end
		e2bd.GetSimulationClockTime = function()
			return e5.customTimeHour
		end
		e2bd.GetDesiredTransitionType = function()
			return e5.timePresetFor(e5.customTimeHour)
		end
		e5.refreshCustomTime()
	elseif e5.wcOrig then
		e2bd.IsArtificialNight = e5.wcOrig.IsArtificialNight
		e2bd.GetSimulationClockTime = e5.wcOrig.GetSimulationClockTime
		e2bd.GetDesiredTransitionType = e5.wcOrig.GetDesiredTransitionType
		e5.wcOrig = nil
		pcall(function()
			e2bd:ApplyLightingTransition(0, true)
		end)
	end
end
pcall(function()
	e2:BindToRenderStep("PX_CustomTime", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
		if e5.customTime and not e5.UNLOADED then
			pcall(function()

			end)
		end
	end)
end)

local e2d9 = e5.getLocalPhysicsRoot
e5.AG_SPEED = 16
e5.AG_TURN_RATE = math.rad(70)
function e5.startAutoGrow()
	if e2d7 then
		return
	end
	e2d7 = task.spawn(function()
		local e2da = math.random() < 0.5 and Enum.KeyCode.A or Enum.KeyCode.D
		local e2db = (e2da == Enum.KeyCode.A) and (-7059 + 7060) or -1
		local e2dc = false
		local e2dd = e5.AG_SPEED
		local e2de = e5.AG_TURN_RATE * e2db
		local e2df = 1
		local e2e0, e2e1
		local function e2e2()
			if not e2dc then
				return
			end
			e2dc = false
			pcall(function()
				e5.VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.V, false, game)
			end)
			pcall(function()
				e5.VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, e2da, false, game)
			end)
		end
		while e5.AUTO_GROW and not e5.UNLOADED do
			local e2e3 = task.wait()
			if e2e3 <= 0 then
				e2e3 = 1 / 60
			end
			local e2e4 = e2d9()
			if e2d8 then
				pcall(function()
					e5.VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.V, false, game)
				end)
				pcall(function()
					e5.VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, e2da, false, game)
				end)
				e2dc = true
				if e2e4 then
					pcall(function()
						local e2e5 = e2e4.CFrame.LookVector
						local e2e6 = Vector3.new(e2e5.X, 0, e2e5.Z)
						if e2e6.Magnitude > 0.01 then
							local e2e7 = math.atan2(e2e6.X, e2e6.Z)
							if e2e1 then
								local e2e8 = e2e7 - e2e1
								if e2e8 > math.pi then
									e2e8 = e2e8 - 2 * math.pi
								elseif e2e8 < -math.pi then
									e2e8 = e2e8 + 2 * math.pi
								end
								local e2e9 = e2e8 / e2e3
								if math.abs(e2e9) > 0.05 then
									e2de = e2e9
								end
							end
							e2e1 = e2e7
						end
						if e2e0 then
							local e2ea = e2e4.Position
							local e2eb = Vector3.new(e2ea.X - e2e0.X, 0, e2ea.Z - e2e0.Z).Magnitude
							local e2ec = e2eb / e2e3
							if e2ec > 1 then
								e2dd = e2ec
							end
						end
						e2e0 = e2e4.Position
						local e2ed = e3.Character and e3.Character:GetAttribute("Scale")
						if type(e2ed) == "number" and e2ed > 0 then
							e2df = e2ed
						end
					end)
				end
			else
				e2e2()
				e2e0, e2e1 = nil, nil
				if e2e4 and not e2e4.Anchored then
					pcall(function()
						local e2ee, e2ef = e2de, e2dd
						local e2f0 = e3.Character and e3.Character:GetAttribute("Scale")
						if type(e2f0) == "number" and e2f0 > 0 and e2df > 0 then
							local e2f1 = e2df / e2f0
							e2ee = e2de * e2f1
							e2ef = e2dd * e2f1
						end
						local e2f2 = e2e4.CFrame.LookVector
						local e2f3 = Vector3.new(e2f2.X, 0, e2f2.Z)
						if e2f3.Magnitude < 0.01 then
							e2f3 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
						end
						e2f3 = e2f3.Unit
						local e2f4 = e2ee * e2e3
						local e2f5, e2f6 = math.cos(e2f4), math.sin(e2f4)
						local e2f7 = Vector3.new(e2f3.X * e2f5 + e2f3.Z * e2f6, 0, -e2f3.X * e2f6 + e2f3.Z * e2f5)
						local e2f8 = e2e4.Position
						e2e4.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(e2f8, e2f8 + e2f7)
						local e2f9 = e2e4.AssemblyLinearVelocity
						e2e4.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(e2f7.X * e2ef, e2f9.Y, e2f7.Z * e2ef)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		e2e2()
		pcall(function()
			e5.VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.V, false, game)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			e5.VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, e2da, false, game)
		end)
		e2d7 = nil
	end)
end
function e5.stopAutoGrow()
	e5.AUTO_GROW = false
	pcall(function()

	end)
	pcall(function()

	end)
	pcall(function()
		local e2fa = e2d9()
		if e2fa and not e2fa.Anchored then
			local e2fb = e2fa.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			e2fa.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, e2fb.Y, 0)
		end
	end)
	e2d7 = nil
end

function e5.readWaterStat()
	local e307, e308, e309 = pcall(function()

function e5.mvWantsRun()
	if e5.UNLOADED then return false end
	if e5.PUMPKIN_FARM or e5.FOSSIL_FARM then return e5.ffState == "flying" and not e5.mvHold() end
	if e5.LEGIT_FARM then return not e5.mvHold() and ((e5.lfHeld and e5.lfHeld.Run) or e5.lfFly ~= nil) or false end
	if e5.AFK_FARM then return not e5.mvHold() and not e5.afkSafetyState and not e5.CLEAN_BREAK and os.clock() - e5.mvRunWantT < 0.3 end
	return os.clock() - e5.mvRunWantT < 3 or (e5.FLY and not e5.UNLOADED) or false
end
function e5.govNext(e4b5, e4b6, e4b7, e4b8)
	local e4b9 = os.clock()
	if e5.mvHold() then
		if e4b9 - e5.mvRunWantT < 1 then
			e5.mvRunWantT = e4b9
		end
		local e4ba = e5.getLocalPhysicsRoot()
		local e4bb = (e4ba and e4ba.Parent and e4ba.Position) or e4b5
		e5.govCommanded, e5.govCommandT = e4bb, e4b9
		return e4bb, true
	end
	local e4bc = e4b6 - e4b5
	if e4bc.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return e4b6, false
	end
	e4b7 = math.min(e4b7 or 0.016, 0.1)
	local e4bd = Vector3.new(e4bc.X, 0, e4bc.Z)
	local e4be = e4bd.Magnitude
	local e4bf = math.abs(e4bc.Y) > e4be * 0.5 + 0.05
	local e4c0, e4c1 = e5.mvSideCap(e4bf), e5.MV_VERT
	if e4b8 then
		e4c0, e4c1 = math.min(e4c0, e4b8), math.min(e4c1, e4b8)
	end
	if e4be > 0.05 then
		e5.mvRunWantT = e4b9
		if not e4bf then
			e5.mvPlatT = e4b9
		end
	end
	local e4c2 = math.min(e4be, e4c0 * e4b7, e5.GOV_STEP_MAX)
	local e4c3 = math.min(e4c1 * e4b7, e5.GOV_STEP_MAX)
	local e4c4 = math.clamp(e4bc.Y, -e4c3, e4c3)
	local e4c5 = e4b5 + Vector3.new(0, e4c4, 0)
	if e4be > 0.001 then
		e4c5 = e4c5 + e4bd * (e4c2 / e4be)
	end
	e5.govCommanded, e5.govCommandT = e4c5, e4b9
	return e4c5, (e4c2 < e4be - 1e-4) or (e4c4 ~= e4bc.Y)
end

function e5.liteGrowthOf(ea2b, ea2c, ea2d)
	if type(ea2d) ~= "table" or ea2b == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local ea2e = ea2d[tostring(ea2b)]

		return nil
	end

		if type(ea32) == "number" and ea32 > ea2e and (not ea30 or ea32 < ea30) then
			ea2f, ea30 = ea31, ea32
		end
	end
	local ea33 = { Stage = tostring(ea2b) }
	if not ea2f then
		ea33.final = true
		return ea33
	end
	ea33.NextStage, ea33.span = ea2f, ea30 - ea2e
	if type(ea2c) == "number" then
		ea33.Delta = math.clamp((ea2c - ea2e) / ea33.span, 0, 1)
	end

end
function e5.fmtLeft(ea34)
	ea34 = math.floor(ea34 + 0.5)
	if ea34 <= 0 then
		return "any moment"
	end
	if ea34 < 60 then
		return "~" .. ea34 .. "s left"
	end
	if ea34 < 3600 then
		return "~" .. math.floor(ea34 / 60) .. "m left"
	end
	return string.format("~%dh%02dm left", math.floor(ea34 / 3600), math.floor(ea34 % 3600 / 60))
end
function e5.litePaceEta(ea35, ea36)
	if type(ea35) ~= "table" then
		return ""
	end
	if ea35.final then
		return "(final stage)"
	end
	local ea37, ea38 = 0, 0
	for ea39, ea3a in ipairs(ea36 or {}) do
		ea37 = ea37 + ea3a[1]
		ea38 = ea38 + ea3a[2]
	end
	if #(ea36 or {}) < 2 or ea38 < 60 or ea37 <= 0 or not ea35.Delta or not ea35.span then
		return "(measuring...)"
	end
	return "(" .. e5.fmtLeft((1 - ea35.Delta) * ea35.span / (ea37 / ea38)) .. " at this pace)"
end
function e5.stageSpan(ea3b)

		return nil
	end

		ea3c and ea3b.Stage and ea3c[tostring(ea3b.Stage)], ea3c and ea3b.NextStage and ea3c[tostring(ea3b.NextStage)]
	if not (ea3d and ea3e) or ea3e <= ea3d then
		return nil
	end
	return ea3e - ea3d
end

do
	local ebb9, ebba, ebbb
	local ebbc = {}
	local function ebbd(ebbe)
		while ebbe and ebbe ~= ebb9 do
			if
				ebbe:IsA("Model")
				and (
					ebbe:GetAttribute("HalloweenPumpkin") ~= nil
					or (ebbe:FindFirstChild("PumpkinPrompt") and ebbe:FindFirstChild("PumpkinModel"))
				)
			then
				ebbc[ebbe] = true
			end
			ebbe = ebbe.Parent
		end
	end
	function e5.getPumpkinCandidates()
		local ebbf = workspace:FindFirstChild("CharacterIgnore")
		if ebbf ~= ebb9 then
			if ebba then
				ebba:Disconnect()
			end
			if ebbb then
				ebbb:Disconnect()
			end
			ebb9 = ebbf
			ebbc = {}
			if ebb9 then
				ebba = ebb9.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(ebc0)
					if
						ebc0.Name ~= "PumpkinPrompt"
						and ebc0.Name ~= "PumpkinModel"
						and not (ebc0:IsA("Model") and ebc0:GetAttribute("HalloweenPumpkin") ~= nil)
					then
						return
					end
					local ebc1 = ebb9
					task.defer(function()
						if not e5.UNLOADED and ebb9 == ebc1 and ebc0:IsDescendantOf(ebc1) then
							ebbd(ebc0)
						end
					end)
				end)
				ebbb = ebb9.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(ebc2)
					ebbc[ebc2] = nil
				end)
				table.insert(e50, ebba)
				table.insert(e50, ebbb)
				for ebc3, ebc4 in ipairs(ebb9:GetDescendants()) do
					ebbd(ebc4)
				end
			end
		end
		return ebbc
	end
end

                                                                           
e5.PUMPKIN_FARM = false
e5.pumpkinFarmStatus = "Off"
function e5.ffOn() return e5.FOSSIL_FARM or e5.PUMPKIN_FARM end
function e5.pumpkinsNow()
 local ebc5 = {}
 for ebc6 in pairs(e5.getPumpkinCandidates()) do
  if ebc6.Parent then ebc5[#ebc5+1] = ebc6 end
 end
 return ebc5
end
function e5.isGiantPumpkin(ebc7)
 return tostring(ebc7:GetAttribute("HalloweenPumpkin")):lower() == "giant"
end
function e5.stopPumpkinFarm()
 local ebc8 = e5.PUMPKIN_FARM
 e5.PUMPKIN_FARM = false
 e5.pumpkinFarmStatus = "Off"
 if e5.fossilFarmCleanup then e5.fossilFarmCleanup() end
 if ebc8 and e5.beginFarmStop then e5.beginFarmStop() end
end

                                                                               
                                                                              
e5.PUMPKIN_COLLECT_RANGE_ENABLED = false
e5.PUMPKIN_COLLECT_RANGE = 1000
e5.pumpkinPromptOriginals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
function e5.restorePumpkinPrompts()
	for ebc9, ebca in pairs(e5.pumpkinPromptOriginals) do
		pcall(function()
			ebc9.MaxActivationDistance = ebca
		end)
		e5.pumpkinPromptOriginals[ebc9] = nil
	end
end
do
	local ebcb = -math.huge
	e5.addStep(6, function()
		if not e5.PUMPKIN_COLLECT_RANGE_ENABLED then
			return
		end
		if os.clock() - ebcb < 0.5 then
			return
		end
		ebcb = os.clock()
		local ebcc = workspace:FindFirstChild("CharacterIgnore")
		if not ebcc then
			e5.restorePumpkinPrompts()
			return
		end
		for ebcd in pairs(e5.getPumpkinCandidates()) do
			if ebcd:IsDescendantOf(ebcc) then
				local ebce = ebcd:FindFirstChild("PumpkinPrompt", true)
				if ebce and ebce:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					if e5.pumpkinPromptOriginals[ebce] == nil then
						e5.pumpkinPromptOriginals[ebce] = ebce.MaxActivationDistance
					end
					if ebce.MaxActivationDistance ~= e5.PUMPKIN_COLLECT_RANGE then
						ebce.MaxActivationDistance = e5.PUMPKIN_COLLECT_RANGE
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

e5.PUMPKIN_ESP = false
e5.PUMPKIN_ESP_DISTANCE = 5000
e5.pumpkinMarkers = {}
function e5.clearPumpkinESP()
	for ebcf, ebd0 in pairs(e5.pumpkinMarkers) do
		ebd0.gui:Destroy()
		e5.pumpkinMarkers[ebcf] = nil
	end
end
do
	local ebd1 = -math.huge
	local ebd2 = -math.huge
	local ebd3 = {}
	local function ebd4(ebd5)
		local ebd6 = ebd5.PrimaryPart or ebd5:FindFirstChild("PumpkinModel", true)
		return ebd6 and ebd6:IsA("BasePart") and ebd6:IsDescendantOf(ebd5) and ebd6 or nil
	end
	local function ebd7(ebd8)
		if not ebd8:IsA("Model") then
			return false
		end
		if ebd8:GetAttribute("HalloweenPumpkin") ~= nil then
			return true
		end
		local ebd9 = ebd8:FindFirstChild("PumpkinPrompt")
		return ebd9 and ebd9:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and ebd8:FindFirstChild("PumpkinModel") ~= nil
	end
	e5.addStep(6, function()
		if not e5.PUMPKIN_ESP then
			if next(e5.pumpkinMarkers) then
				e5.clearPumpkinESP()
			end
			return
		end
		local ebda = workspace:FindFirstChild("CharacterIgnore")
		if not ebda then
			e5.clearPumpkinESP()
			ebd3 = {}
			ebd1 = -math.huge
			return
		end
		local ebdb = os.clock()
		if ebdb - ebd2 < 0.25 then
			return
		end
		ebd2 = ebdb
		local ebdc = 0
		ebd3 = e5.getPumpkinCandidates()
		local ebdd = e5.getLocalRoot()
		local ebde = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local ebdf = ebdd and ebdd.Position or (ebde and ebde.CFrame.Position)
		local ebe0 = {}
		for ebe1 in pairs(ebd3) do
			if ebe1:IsDescendantOf(ebda) then
				local ebe2 = ebd4(ebe1)
				local ebe3 = ebe1:FindFirstChild("PumpkinPrompt", true)
				local ebe4 = not ebe3 or not ebe3:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or ebe3.Enabled
				if ebe2 and ebdf and ebe4 then
					local ebe5 = (ebdf - ebe2.Position).Magnitude
					if ebe5 <= e5.PUMPKIN_ESP_DISTANCE then
						ebe0[ebe1] = true
						local ebe6 = e5.pumpkinMarkers[ebe1]
						if ebe6 and (not ebe6.gui.Parent or ebe6.gui.Adornee ~= ebe2) then
							ebe6.gui:Destroy()
							e5.pumpkinMarkers[ebe1] = nil
							ebe6 = nil
						end
						if not ebe6 then
							if ebdc >= 6 then
								continue
							end
							ebdc = ebdc + 1
							local ebe7 = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
							ebe7.Name = "EclipseHalloweenPumpkinESP"
							ebe7.Adornee = ebe2
							ebe7.AlwaysOnTop = true
							ebe7.LightInfluence = 0
							ebe7.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 42)
							ebe7.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, ebe2.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
							ebe7.MaxDistance = e5.PUMPKIN_ESP_DISTANCE
							local ebe8 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
							ebe8.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
							ebe8.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							ebe8.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 45)
							ebe8.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
							ebe8.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
							ebe8.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
							ebe8.TextSize = 15
							ebe8.Parent = ebe7
							ebe7.Parent = ebe2
							ebe6 = { gui = ebe7, label = ebe8 }
							e5.pumpkinMarkers[ebe1] = ebe6
						end
						local ebe9 = ebe1:GetAttribute("HalloweenPumpkin")
						local ebea = type(ebe9) == "string" and ebe9 ~= "" and (" (" .. ebe9 .. ")") or ""
						local ebeb = "Pumpkin" .. ebea .. "\n" .. math.floor(ebe5 + 0.5) .. " studs"
						if ebe6.text ~= ebeb then
							ebe6.label.Text = ebeb
							ebe6.text = ebeb
						end
						if ebe6.gui.MaxDistance ~= e5.PUMPKIN_ESP_DISTANCE then
							ebe6.gui.MaxDistance = e5.PUMPKIN_ESP_DISTANCE
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for ebec, ebed in pairs(e5.pumpkinMarkers) do
			if not ebe0[ebec] then
				ebed.gui:Destroy()
				e5.pumpkinMarkers[ebec] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

	e5.FOSSIL_FARM, e5.AFK_FARM, e5.FORCE_EAT = false, false, false
	e5.CARRY_CORPSE, e5.WATER_ANYWHERE = false, false
	e5.LEGIT_FARM, e5.AUTO_SWITCH, e5.FARM_TIMER, e5.CORPSE_INF_ESP = false, false, false, false
	e5.REJOIN = false
	e5.FPS_SAVER = false
	e5.NO_ATK_COOLDOWN, e5.FISH_ESP, e5.NO_BLUR = false, false, false
	e5.NO_WEATHER = false
	e5.SKIN_SELECTED = "Default"
	e5.FLY, e5.QUICK_TURN, e5.MOB_SHOW_TURN = false, false, false
	e5.AUTO_FLY, e5.TP_CORPSE, e5.BIOME_TRAVEL = false, false, false
	e5.AUTO_SAVE, e5.AUTO_SAVE_BLEED, e5.MOD_KICK = false, false, false
	e5.STATS_CARD, e5.MMAP_ON = false, false
	e5.UNLIMITED_ZOOM, e5.FOV_ENABLED = false, false
	if (tonumber(e5.HITBOX_MULTIPLIER) or (-2137 + 2138)) > 5 then
		e5.HITBOX_MULTIPLIER = 5
	end
	if (tonumber(e5.REACH_MULTIPLIER) or (-4165 + 4166)) > 5 then
		e5.REACH_MULTIPLIER = 5
	end
end
e5.freeLock()
function e5.displayName(ebee)
	local ebef = (tostring(ebee or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
	local ebf0 = e5.MENU_LAYOUT.RENAME and e5.MENU_LAYOUT.RENAME[ebef]
	return ebf0 or (ebef:gsub("^Enable%s+", ""))
end

local BaseURL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deividcomsono/Obsidian/refs/heads/main/"
local CustomImageManager = {}
local CustomImageManagerAssets = {
    TransparencyTexture = {
        RobloxId = 139785960036434,
        Path = "Obsidian/assets/TransparencyTexture.png",
        URL = BaseURL .. "assets/TransparencyTexture.png",

        Id = nil,
    },

    SaturationMap = {
        RobloxId = 4155801252,
        Path = "Obsidian/assets/SaturationMap.png",
        URL = BaseURL .. "assets/SaturationMap.png",

        Id = nil,
    },

    LoadingIcon = {
        RobloxId = 97544096941083,
        Path = "Obsidian/assets/LoadingIcon.png",
        URL = BaseURL .. "assets/LoadingIcon.png",

        Id = nil,
    },

    CheckIcon = {
        RobloxId = 97682394690683,
        Path = "Obsidian/assets/CheckIcon.png",
        URL = BaseURL .. "assets/CheckIcon.png",

        Id = nil,
    },
}
do
    local function RecursiveCreatePath(Path: string, IsFile: boolean?)
        if not isfolder or not makefolder then
            return
        end

        local Segments = Path:split("/")
        local TraversedPath = ""

        if IsFile then
            table.remove(Segments, #Segments)
        end

        for _, Segment in ipairs(Segments) do
            if not isfolder(TraversedPath .. Segment) then
                makefolder(TraversedPath .. Segment)
            end

            TraversedPath = TraversedPath .. Segment .. "/"
        end

        return TraversedPath
    end

    function CustomImageManager.AddAsset(
        AssetName: string,
        RobloxAssetId: number,
        URL: string,
        ForceRedownload: boolean?
    )
        if CustomImageManagerAssets[AssetName] ~= nil then
            error(string.format("Asset %q already exists", AssetName))
        end

        assert(typeof(RobloxAssetId) == "number", "RobloxAssetId must be a number")

        CustomImageManagerAssets[AssetName] = {
            RobloxId = RobloxAssetId,
            Path = string.format("Obsidian/custom_assets/%s", AssetName),
            URL = URL,

            Id = nil,
        }

        CustomImageManager.DownloadAsset(AssetName, ForceRedownload)
    end

    function CustomImageManager.GetAsset(AssetName: string)
        if not CustomImageManagerAssets[AssetName] then
            return nil
        end

        local AssetData = CustomImageManagerAssets[AssetName]
        if AssetData.Id then
            return AssetData.Id
        end

        local AssetID = string.format("rbxassetid://%s", AssetData.RobloxId)

        if getcustomasset then
            local Success, NewID = pcall(getcustomasset, AssetData.Path)

            if Success and NewID then
                AssetID = NewID
            end
        end

        AssetData.Id = AssetID
        return AssetID
    end

    function CustomImageManager.DownloadAsset(AssetName: string, ForceRedownload: boolean?)
        if not getcustomasset or not writefile or not isfile then
            return false, "missing functions"
        end

        local AssetData = CustomImageManagerAssets[AssetName]

        RecursiveCreatePath(AssetData.Path, true)

        if ForceRedownload ~= true and isfile(AssetData.Path) then
            return true, nil
        end

        local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
            writefile(AssetData.Path, game:HttpGet(AssetData.URL))
        end)

        return success, errorMessage
    end

    for AssetName, _ in CustomImageManagerAssets do
        CustomImageManager.DownloadAsset(AssetName)
    end
end

--// Scheme Functions \\--
local SchemeReplaceAlias = {
    RedColor = "Red",
    WhiteColor = "White",
    DarkColor = "Dark"
}

local SchemeAlias = {
    Red = "RedColor",
    White = "WhiteColor",
    Dark = "DarkColor"
}

local function GetSchemeValue(Index)
    if not Index then
        return nil
    end

    local ReplaceAliasIndex = SchemeReplaceAlias[Index]
    if ReplaceAliasIndex and Library.Scheme[ReplaceAliasIndex] ~= nil then
        Library.Scheme[Index] = Library.Scheme[ReplaceAliasIndex]
        Library.Scheme[ReplaceAliasIndex] = nil

        return Library.Scheme[Index]
    end

    local AliasIndex = SchemeAlias[Index]
    if AliasIndex and Library.Scheme[AliasIndex] ~= nil then
        warn(string.format("Scheme Value %q is deprecated, please use %q instead.", Index, AliasIndex))
        return Library.Scheme[AliasIndex]
    end

    return Library.Scheme[Index]
end

local function GetTextStrokeColor(): Color3
    local Color = Library.Scheme.FontColor
    return (Color.R * 0.299 + Color.G * 0.587 + Color.B * 0.114) > 0.5 and Library.Scheme.DarkColor or Library.Scheme.WhiteColor
end

--// Basic Functions \\--
local function WaitForEvent(Event, Timeout, Condition)
    local Bindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
    local Connection = Event:Once(function(...)
        if not Condition or typeof(Condition) == "function" and Condition(...) then
            Bindable:Fire(true)
        else
            Bindable:Fire(false)
        end
    end)
    task.delay(Timeout, function()
        Connection:Disconnect()
        Bindable:Fire(false)
    end)

    local Result = Bindable.Event:Wait()
    Bindable:Destroy()

    return Result
end

local function IsMouseInput(Input: InputObject, IncludeM2: boolean?)
    return Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or (IncludeM2 == true and Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
        or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end
local function IsClickInput(Input: InputObject, IncludeM2: boolean?)
    return IsMouseInput(Input, IncludeM2)
        and Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin
        and Library.IsRobloxFocused
end
local function IsHoverInput(Input: InputObject)
    return (Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
        and Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Change
end
local function IsDragInput(Input: InputObject, IncludeM2: boolean?)
    return IsMouseInput(Input, IncludeM2)
        and (Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin or Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Change)
        and Library.IsRobloxFocused
end
local function IsMouseClickInput(Input: InputObject)
    return Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or
        Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or
        Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
end
local function IsMovementInput(Input: InputObject)
    return (Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
        and Library.IsRobloxFocused
end

local function GetTableSize(Table: { [any]: any })
    local Size = 0

    for _, _ in Table do
        Size += 1
    end

    return Size
end
local function IsSequentialArray(Table: { [any]: any })
    for Key in Table do
        if typeof(Key) ~= "number" or Key < 1 or Key % 1 ~= 0 then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

local function StopTween(Tween: TweenBase, Destroy: boolean?)
    if not Tween then
        return
    end

    if Tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
        Tween:Cancel()
    end

    if Destroy == true then
        pcall(Tween.Destroy, Tween)
    end
end

local function Trim(Text: string)
    return Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end
local function Round(Value, Rounding)
    assert(Rounding >= 0, "Invalid rounding number.")

    if Rounding == 0 then
        return math.floor(Value)
    end

    return tonumber(string.format("%." .. Rounding .. "f", Value))
end

--// Fuzzy Search \\--
local function LowerText(Text: string): string
    return (Text:lower():gsub("[\195\206\208][\128-\191]", function(Char)
        local Code = utf8.codepoint(Char)
        if (Code >= 0xC0 and Code <= 0xDE and Code ~= 0xD7) or (Code >= 0x391 and Code <= 0x3AB) or (Code >= 0x410 and Code <= 0x42F) then
            return utf8.char(Code + 32)
        elseif Code >= 0x400 and Code <= 0x40F then
            return utf8.char(Code + 80)
        end

        return Char
    end))
end

local function FuzzyScore(Text: string, Search: string): (boolean, number)
    if Search == "" then
        return true, 0
    end
    if Text == "" then
        return false, 0
    end

    --// Fast path: literal substring match (also the best possible score) \\--
    local ExactIdx = Text:find(Search, 1, true)
    if ExactIdx then
        local PrevChar = ExactIdx > 1 and Text:sub(ExactIdx - 1, ExactIdx - 1) or ""
        local AtBoundary = ExactIdx == 1 or PrevChar:match("[%s%p_]") ~= nil

        return true, 1e5 - ExactIdx + (AtBoundary and 500 or 0) + (Search:len() * 5)
    end

    --// Fallback: fuzzy, in-order, non-consecutive character matching \\--
    local TextChars, SearchChars = {}, {}
    for Char in Text:gmatch(utf8.charpattern) do table.insert(TextChars, Char) end
    for Char in Search:gmatch(utf8.charpattern) do table.insert(SearchChars, Char) end

    local TextLen, SearchLen = #TextChars, #SearchChars
    if SearchLen > TextLen then
        return false, 0
    end

    local SearchIdx = 1
    local Score = 0
    local RunLength = 0
    local LastMatchIdx = 0

    for TextIdx = 1, TextLen do
        if SearchIdx > SearchLen then
            break
        end

        if TextChars[TextIdx] == SearchChars[SearchIdx] then
            local PrevChar = TextIdx > 1 and TextChars[TextIdx - 1] or ""
            local AtBoundary = TextIdx == 1 or PrevChar:match("[%s%p_]") ~= nil

            RunLength = (LastMatchIdx == TextIdx - 1) and (RunLength + 1) or 1
            Score += 1 + (AtBoundary and 6 or 0) + math.min(RunLength - 1, 5) * 3

            LastMatchIdx = TextIdx
            SearchIdx += 1
        end
    end

    if SearchIdx <= SearchLen then
        return false, 0 --// Not every Search character was found, in order
    end

    Score -= (LastMatchIdx - SearchLen) * 0.05 --// Slightly favour tighter matches
    return true, Score
end

local function NormalizeSearch(Search: string): string
    return (Search:gsub("%s+", ""))
end

local function TryFuzzyMatch(Text: any, Search: string): (boolean, number)
    if typeof(Text) ~= "string" or Text == "" then
        return false, 0
    end

    return FuzzyScore(LowerText(Text), Search)
end

local function FuzzyMatchScore(Text: any, Search: string): number
    if typeof(Text) ~= "string" or Text == "" then
        return 0
    end

    local Normalized = NormalizeSearch(LowerText(Text))
    local Matched, Score = FuzzyScore(Normalized, Search)
    if not Matched then
        return 0
    end

    if Normalized == Search then
        Score += 1000
    end

    return Score
end

local function MatchesSearch(ElementInfo, Search: string, ForceMatch: boolean?): boolean
    if not ElementInfo then
        return false
    end
    if ForceMatch then
        return true
    end

    if TryFuzzyMatch(ElementInfo.Text, Search) then
        return true
    end
    if TryFuzzyMatch(ElementInfo.Tooltip, Search) then
        return true
    end
    if TryFuzzyMatch(ElementInfo.DisabledTooltip, Search) then
        return true
    end

    --// Optional: search inside Dropdown value lists, so e.g. searching a specific option name reveals the Dropdown that contains it \\--
    if typeof(ElementInfo.Values) == "table" then
        local Checked = 0
        for Key, Value in ElementInfo.Values do
            Checked += 1
            if Checked > 200 then
                break
            end

            if TryFuzzyMatch(Value, Search) or (typeof(Value) ~= "string" and TryFuzzyMatch(tostring(Value), Search)) then
                return true
            end
            if typeof(Key) == "string" and TryFuzzyMatch(Key, Search) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function GetPlayers(ExcludeLocalPlayer: boolean?)
    local PlayerList = Players:GetPlayers()

    if ExcludeLocalPlayer then
        local Idx = table.find(PlayerList, LocalPlayer)
        if Idx then
            table.remove(PlayerList, Idx)
        end
    end

    table.sort(PlayerList, function(Player1, Player2)
        return Player1.Name:lower() < Player2.Name:lower()
    end)

    return PlayerList
end
local function GetTeams()
    local TeamList = Teams:GetTeams()

    table.sort(TeamList, function(Team1, Team2)
        return Team1.Name:lower() < Team2.Name:lower()
    end)

    return TeamList
end

function Library:UpdateDependencyBoxes()
    for _, Depbox in Library.DependencyBoxes do
        Depbox:Update(true)
    end

    if Library.Searching then
        Library:UpdateSearch(Library.SearchText)
    end
end

function Library:UpdateAddons(Parent)
    if not Parent or not Parent.Addons then
        return
    end

    for _, Addon in Parent.Addons do
        Addon:Update()
    end
end

local function CheckDepbox(Box, Search, ForceVisible: boolean?)
    local VisibleElements = 0
    local BestScore = 0

    for _, ElementInfo in Box.Elements do
        if ElementInfo.Type == "Divider" then
            ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = false
            continue
        elseif ElementInfo.SubButton then
            --// Check if any of the Buttons Name matches with Search
            local Visible = false

            --// Check if Search matches Element's Name and if Element is Visible
            if MatchesSearch(ElementInfo, Search, ForceVisible) and ElementInfo.Visible then
                Visible = true
                BestScore = math.max(BestScore, FuzzyMatchScore(ElementInfo.Text, Search))
            else
                ElementInfo.Base.Visible = false
            end
            if MatchesSearch(ElementInfo.SubButton, Search, ForceVisible) and ElementInfo.SubButton.Visible then
                Visible = true
                BestScore = math.max(BestScore, FuzzyMatchScore(ElementInfo.SubButton.Text, Search))
            else
                ElementInfo.SubButton.Base.Visible = false
            end
            ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = Visible
            if Visible then
                VisibleElements += 1
            end

            continue
        end

        --// Check if Search matches Element's Name and if Element is Visible
        if ElementInfo.Text and MatchesSearch(ElementInfo, Search, ForceVisible) and ElementInfo.Visible then
            ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = true
            VisibleElements += 1
            BestScore = math.max(BestScore, FuzzyMatchScore(ElementInfo.Text, Search))
        else
            ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = false
        end
    end

    for _, Depbox in Box.DependencyBoxes do
        if not Depbox.Visible then
            continue
        end

        local DepVisible, DepScore = CheckDepbox(Depbox, Search, ForceVisible)
        VisibleElements += DepVisible
        if DepScore > BestScore then
            BestScore = DepScore
        end
    end

    Box.Holder.Visible = VisibleElements > 0
    return VisibleElements, BestScore
end
local function RestoreDepbox(Box)
    for _, ElementInfo in Box.Elements do
        ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = ElementInfo.Visible ~= false

        if ElementInfo.SubButton then
            ElementInfo.Base.Visible = ElementInfo.Visible
            ElementInfo.SubButton.Base.Visible = ElementInfo.SubButton.Visible
        end
    end

    for _, Depbox in Box.DependencyBoxes do
        RestoreDepbox(Depbox)
    end

    Box.Holder.Visible = Box.Visible
    if Box.Visible then
        Box:Resize()
    end
end

--// Pop Out
function SyncPopOutVisibility(Box: any)
    if not Box.PopOutFloat then
        return
    end

    Box.PopOutFloat.Visible = Box.BoxHolder.Visible ~= false and Box.Visible ~= false
end

local function RegisterPopOutClone(Source: Instance, Clone: Instance)
    local SourceProps = Library.Registry[Source]
    if SourceProps then
        local CloneProps = {}
        for Property, Index in SourceProps do
            if Property ~= "FontFace" then
                CloneProps[Property] = Index
            end
        end
        if next(CloneProps) then
            Library.Registry[Clone] = CloneProps
        end
    end

    local SourceChildren = Source:GetChildren()
    local CloneChildren = Clone:GetChildren()
    for Index = 1, math.min(#SourceChildren, #CloneChildren) do
        RegisterPopOutClone(SourceChildren[Index], CloneChildren[Index])
    end
end

local function DimPopOutClone(Root: GuiObject)
    for _, Descendant in Root:QueryDescendants("TextLabel, TextButton, TextBox") do
        Descendant.TextTransparency = math.max(Descendant.TextTransparency, 0.45)
    end

    for _, Descendant in Root:QueryDescendants("ImageLabel, ImageButton") do
        Descendant.ImageTransparency = math.max(Descendant.ImageTransparency, 0.45)
    end

    for _, Descendant in Root:QueryDescendants("GuiButton") do
        Descendant.Active = false
        Descendant.AutoButtonColor = false
    end
end

local function IsScreenPointOutsideMain(Point: Vector2): boolean
    local MainFrame = Library.Window and Library.Window.MainFrame
    if not MainFrame or not Library.Toggled or not MainFrame.Visible then
        return true
    end

    return not Library:MouseIsOverFrame(MainFrame, Point)
end

local function GetTopFloatAt(Point: Vector2): GuiObject?
    local Best: GuiObject? = nil
    local BestOrder = -math.huge
    local Floats = Library.Floats

    for _, Surface in Library.DraggableElements do
        if not Surface or not Surface.Parent or not Surface.Visible then
            continue
        end
        if Floats and Surface.Parent ~= Floats then
            continue
        end
        if not Library:MouseIsOverFrame(Surface, Point) then
            continue
        end

        local SiblingIndex = tonumber(select(2, pcall(function() return Surface:GetSiblingIndex() end))) or 0
        local Order = Surface.ZIndex * 100000 + SiblingIndex
        if Order >= BestOrder then
            BestOrder = Order
            Best = Surface
        end
    end

    return Best
end

local function GetPopOutBodyMaxHeight(Box: any, Reserved: number): number
    local Float = Box.PopOutFloat
    local ScreenGui = Library.ScreenGui
    if not Float or not ScreenGui then
        return math.huge
    end

    local Gap = 12 * Library.DPIScale
    local MaxBottom = ScreenGui.AbsolutePosition.Y + ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize.Y - Gap
    local Available = math.min(MaxBottom - Float.AbsolutePosition.Y, ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize.Y * 0.9)
    local ScreenMax = math.max(0, Available / Library.DPIScale - Reserved)

    local CustomMax = Box.PopOutMaxHeight
    if typeof(CustomMax) == "number" then
        return math.min(ScreenMax, math.max(0, CustomMax))
    end

    return ScreenMax
end

--// Search
local function ApplySearchToTab(Tab, Search)
    if not Tab then
        return false, 0
    end

    local HasVisible = false
    local BestScore = 0

    --// If the Tab itself matches Search (by name/description), don't filter out its contents -- pull everything in the Tab along with it \\--
    local TabMatches = TryFuzzyMatch(Tab.Name, Search) or TryFuzzyMatch(Tab.Description, Search)
    BestScore = math.max(BestScore, FuzzyMatchScore(Tab.Name, Search), FuzzyMatchScore(Tab.Description, Search))

    for _, Groupbox in Tab.Groupboxes do
        if Groupbox.Visible == false then
            continue
        end

        --// Optional: matching the Groupbox's own name/description reveals every element inside it, without needing each one to match too
        local GroupboxMatches = TabMatches or (TryFuzzyMatch(Groupbox.Name, Search) or TryFuzzyMatch(Groupbox.Description, Search))
        BestScore = math.max(BestScore, FuzzyMatchScore(Groupbox.Name, Search), FuzzyMatchScore(Groupbox.Description, Search))

        local VisibleElements = 0
        for _, ElementInfo in Groupbox.Elements do
            if ElementInfo.Type == "Divider" then
                ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = false
                continue
            elseif ElementInfo.SubButton then
                --// Check if any of the Buttons Name matches with Search
                local Visible = false
                if MatchesSearch(ElementInfo, Search, GroupboxMatches) and ElementInfo.Visible then
                    Visible = true
                    BestScore = math.max(BestScore, FuzzyMatchScore(ElementInfo.Text, Search))
                else
                    ElementInfo.Base.Visible = false
                end

                if MatchesSearch(ElementInfo.SubButton, Search, GroupboxMatches) and ElementInfo.SubButton.Visible then
                    Visible = true
                    BestScore = math.max(BestScore, FuzzyMatchScore(ElementInfo.SubButton.Text, Search))
                else
                    ElementInfo.SubButton.Base.Visible = false
                end

                ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = Visible
                if Visible then
                    VisibleElements += 1
                end

                continue
            end

            --// Check if Search matches Element's Name and if Element is Visible
            if ElementInfo.Text and MatchesSearch(ElementInfo, Search, GroupboxMatches) and ElementInfo.Visible then
                ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = true
                VisibleElements += 1
                BestScore = math.max(BestScore, FuzzyMatchScore(ElementInfo.Text, Search))
            else
                ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = false
            end
        end

        for _, Depbox in Groupbox.DependencyBoxes do
            if not Depbox.Visible then
                continue
            end

            local DepVisible, DepScore = CheckDepbox(Depbox, Search, GroupboxMatches)
            VisibleElements += DepVisible
            if DepScore > BestScore then
                BestScore = DepScore
            end
        end

        --// Update Groupbox Size and Visibility if found any element
        if VisibleElements > 0 then
            Groupbox:Resize()
            HasVisible = true
        end
        Groupbox.BoxHolder.Visible = VisibleElements > 0
        SyncPopOutVisibility(Groupbox)
    end

    for _, Tabbox in Tab.Tabboxes do
        local VisibleTabs = 0
        local VisibleElements = {}
        local SubTabScores = {}

        for _, SubTab in Tabbox.Tabs do
            VisibleElements[SubTab] = 0

            --// Optional: matching a Tabbox sub-tab's own name reveals every element inside it, without needing each one to match too
            local SubTabMatches = TabMatches or TryFuzzyMatch(SubTab.Name, Search)
            local SubScore = FuzzyMatchScore(SubTab.Name, Search)
            BestScore = math.max(BestScore, SubScore)

            for _, ElementInfo in SubTab.Elements do
                if ElementInfo.Type == "Divider" then
                    ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = false
                    continue
                elseif ElementInfo.SubButton then
                    --// Check if any of the Buttons Name matches with Search
                    local Visible = false
                    if MatchesSearch(ElementInfo, Search, SubTabMatches) and ElementInfo.Visible then
                        Visible = true
                        local ElementScore = FuzzyMatchScore(ElementInfo.Text, Search)
                        SubScore = math.max(SubScore, ElementScore)
                        BestScore = math.max(BestScore, ElementScore)
                    else
                        ElementInfo.Base.Visible = false
                    end

                    if MatchesSearch(ElementInfo.SubButton, Search, SubTabMatches) and ElementInfo.SubButton.Visible then
                        Visible = true
                        local ElementScore = FuzzyMatchScore(ElementInfo.SubButton.Text, Search)
                        SubScore = math.max(SubScore, ElementScore)
                        BestScore = math.max(BestScore, ElementScore)
                    else
                        ElementInfo.SubButton.Base.Visible = false
                    end

                    ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = Visible
                    if Visible then
                        VisibleElements[SubTab] += 1
                    end

                    continue
                end

                --// Check if Search matches Element's Name and if Element is Visible
                if ElementInfo.Text and MatchesSearch(ElementInfo, Search, SubTabMatches) and ElementInfo.Visible then
                    ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = true
                    VisibleElements[SubTab] += 1
                    local ElementScore = FuzzyMatchScore(ElementInfo.Text, Search)
                    SubScore = math.max(SubScore, ElementScore)
                    BestScore = math.max(BestScore, ElementScore)
                else
                    ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = false
                end
            end

            for _, Depbox in SubTab.DependencyBoxes do
                if not Depbox.Visible then
                    continue
                end

                local DepVisible, DepScore = CheckDepbox(Depbox, Search, SubTabMatches)
                VisibleElements[SubTab] += DepVisible
                SubScore = math.max(SubScore, DepScore)
                BestScore = math.max(BestScore, DepScore)
            end

            SubTabScores[SubTab] = SubScore
        end

        local BestSubTab = nil
        local BestSubScore = -1

        for SubTab, Visible in VisibleElements do
            SubTab.ButtonHolder.Visible = Visible > 0
            if Visible > 0 then
                VisibleTabs += 1
                HasVisible = true

                local SubScore = SubTabScores[SubTab] or 0
                if SubScore > BestSubScore then
                    BestSubScore = SubScore
                    BestSubTab = SubTab
                end
            end
        end

        local ActiveSubTab = Tabbox.ActiveTab
        local ActiveSubVisible = ActiveSubTab and (VisibleElements[ActiveSubTab] or 0) > 0
        local ActiveSubScore = ActiveSubTab and (SubTabScores[ActiveSubTab] or -1) or -1

        if ActiveSubVisible and ActiveSubScore >= BestSubScore then
            ActiveSubTab:Resize()
        elseif BestSubTab then
            BestSubTab:Show()
        end

        --// Update Tabbox Visibility if any visible
        Tabbox.BoxHolder.Visible = VisibleTabs > 0
        SyncPopOutVisibility(Tabbox)
    end

    return HasVisible, BestScore
end

local function ResetTab(Tab)
    if not Tab then
        return
    end

    for _, Groupbox in Tab.Groupboxes do
        for _, ElementInfo in Groupbox.Elements do
            ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = ElementInfo.Visible ~= false

            if ElementInfo.SubButton then
                ElementInfo.Base.Visible = ElementInfo.Visible
                ElementInfo.SubButton.Base.Visible = ElementInfo.SubButton.Visible
            end
        end

        for _, Depbox in Groupbox.DependencyBoxes do
            RestoreDepbox(Depbox)
        end

        Groupbox:Resize()
        Groupbox.BoxHolder.Visible = Groupbox.Visible ~= false
        SyncPopOutVisibility(Groupbox)
    end

    for _, Tabbox in Tab.Tabboxes do
        for _, SubTab in Tabbox.Tabs do
            for _, ElementInfo in SubTab.Elements do
                ElementInfo.Holder.Visible = ElementInfo.Visible ~= false

                if ElementInfo.SubButton then
                    ElementInfo.Base.Visible = ElementInfo.Visible
                    ElementInfo.SubButton.Base.Visible = ElementInfo.SubButton.Visible
                end
            end

            for _, Depbox in SubTab.DependencyBoxes do
                RestoreDepbox(Depbox)
            end

            SubTab.ButtonHolder.Visible = true
        end

        if Tabbox.ActiveTab then
            Tabbox.ActiveTab:Resize()
        end
        Tabbox.BoxHolder.Visible = true
        SyncPopOutVisibility(Tabbox)
    end
end

function Library:UpdateSearch(SearchText)
    Library.SearchText = SearchText

    local TabsToSearch = {}
    for _, Tab in Library.Tabs do
        if typeof(Tab) == "table" and not Tab.IsKeyTab and not Tab.IsCustomTab then
            table.insert(TabsToSearch, Tab)
        end
    end

    for _, Tab in TabsToSearch do
        ResetTab(Tab)
    end

    local Search = NormalizeSearch(LowerText(SearchText))
    if Trim(Search) == "" then
        Library.Searching = false
        Library.LastSearchTab = nil
        return
    end
    if not Library.GlobalSearch and Library.ActiveTab and Library.ActiveTab.IsKeyTab then
        Library.Searching = false
        Library.LastSearchTab = nil
        return
    end

    Library.Searching = true

    local BestTab = nil
    local BestScore = -1
    local ActiveScore = -1
    local ActiveHasVisible = false

    for _, Tab in TabsToSearch do
        local HasVisible, Score = ApplySearchToTab(Tab, Search)
        if not HasVisible then
            continue
        end

        if Tab == Library.ActiveTab then
            ActiveHasVisible = true
            ActiveScore = Score
        end
        if Score > BestScore then
            BestScore = Score
            BestTab = Tab
        end
    end

    if not Library.GlobalSearch then
        for _, Tab in TabsToSearch do
            if Tab ~= BestTab then
                ResetTab(Tab)
            end
        end
    end

    local StayOnActive = ActiveHasVisible and ActiveScore >= BestScore
    if StayOnActive and Library.ActiveTab then
        Library.ActiveTab:RefreshSides()
    elseif BestTab then
        local SearchMarker = SearchText
        task.defer(function()
            if Library.SearchText ~= SearchMarker then
                return
            end

            if Library.ActiveTab ~= BestTab then
                BestTab:Show()
            elseif Library.ActiveTab then
                Library.ActiveTab:RefreshSides()
            end
        end)
    end

    Library.LastSearchTab = nil
end

function Library:AddToRegistry(Instance, Properties)
    Library.Registry[Instance] = Properties
end

function Library:RemoveFromRegistry(Instance)
    Library.Registry[Instance] = nil
end

function Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry()
    for Instance, Properties in Library.Registry do
        for Property, Index in Properties do
            local SchemeValue = GetSchemeValue(Index)

            if SchemeValue or typeof(Index) == "function" then
                Instance[Property] = SchemeValue or Index()
            end
        end
    end
end

function Library:SetDPIScale(DPIScale: number)
    Library.DPIScale = DPIScale / 100
    Library.MinSize = Library.OriginalMinSize * Library.DPIScale

    for _, UIScale in Library.Scales do
        UIScale.Scale = Library.DPIScale - (tonumber(Library.ScalesOffset[UIScale]) or 0)
    end

    for _, Option in Options do
        if Option.Type == "Dropdown" then
            Option:RecalculateListSize()
            Option:RefreshPool()
        end
    end

    for _, Notification in Library.Notifications do
        Notification:Resize()
    end
end

function Library:GiveSignal(Connection: RBXScriptConnection | RBXScriptSignal)
    local ConnectionType = typeof(Connection)
    if Connection and (ConnectionType == "RBXScriptConnection" or ConnectionType == "RBXScriptSignal") then
        table.insert(Library.Signals, Connection)
    end

    return Connection
end

function IsValidCustomIcon(Icon: string)
    return typeof(Icon) == "string" and (Icon:match("^rbxasset://textures/") or Icon:match("roblox%.com/asset/%?id=") or Icon:match("rbxthumb://type="))
end

local function IsCustomAssetIcon(Icon: string, IncludeAssetId: boolean)
    return typeof(Icon) == "string" and (Icon:match("^content://") or (Icon:match("^rbxasset://%x+/") or Icon:match("^rbxasset://[^/]+/")) or (IncludeAssetId == true and Icon:match("^rbxassetid://")))
end

type Icon = {
    Url: string,
    Id: number,
    IconName: string,
    ImageRectOffset: Vector2,
    ImageRectSize: Vector2,
    FontFace: Font?,
    Text: string?,
    Custom: boolean?,
}

type IconModule = {
    Icons: { string },
    GetAsset: (Name: string) -> Icon?,
}

local FetchIcons = false
local Icons: IconModule | nil = nil

function Library:GetIcon(IconName: string): Icon?
    if not FetchIcons or not Icons then
        return nil
    end

    local Success, Icon = pcall(Icons.GetAsset, IconName)
    return if Success then Icon else nil
end

function Library:GetCustomIcon(IconName: string): any
    if not IconName then
        return nil
    end

    if tonumber(IconName) then
        IconName = string.format("rbxassetid://%s", tostring(IconName))
    end

    if IsCustomAssetIcon(IconName, true) then
        return {
            Url = IconName,
            ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero,
            ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero,
        }
    elseif IsValidCustomIcon(IconName) then
        return {
            Url = IconName,
            ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero,
            ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero,
            Custom = true,
        }
    end

    local LucideIcon = Library:GetIcon(IconName)
    if LucideIcon then
        return LucideIcon
    end

    return nil
end

function Library:Validate(Table: { [string]: any }, Template: { [string]: any }): { [string]: any }
    if typeof(Table) ~= "table" then
        return Template
    end

    for k, v in Template do
        if typeof(k) == "number" then
            continue
        end

        if typeof(v) == "table" then
            Table[k] = Library:Validate(Table[k], v)
        elseif Table[k] == nil then
            Table[k] = v
        end
    end

    return Table
end

--// Creator Functions \\--
local function FillInstance(Table: { [string]: any }, Instance: GuiObject)
    local ThemeProperties = Library.Registry[Instance] or {}

    for key, value in Table do
        if key ~= "Text" then
            local SchemeValue = GetSchemeValue(value)

            if SchemeValue or typeof(value) == "function" then
                ThemeProperties[key] = value
                value = SchemeValue or value()
            else
                ThemeProperties[key] = nil
            end
        end

        Instance[key] = value
    end

    if GetTableSize(ThemeProperties) > 0 then
        Library.Registry[Instance] = ThemeProperties
    end
end

local function New(ClassName: string, Properties: { [string]: any }): any
    local Instance = Instance.new(ClassName)

    if Templates[ClassName] then
        FillInstance(Templates[ClassName], Instance)
    end
    FillInstance(Properties, Instance)

    if Properties["Parent"] and not Properties["ZIndex"] then
        pcall(function()
            Instance.ZIndex = Properties.Parent.ZIndex
        end)
    end

    return Instance
end

--// Icon Instances \\--
local IconTextProperties = { ImageColor3 = "TextColor3", ImageTransparency = "TextTransparency" }
local IconSharedProperties = { "Name", "AnchorPoint", "Position", "Size", "SizeConstraint", "LayoutOrder", "ZIndex", "Visible", "Rotation", "ImageColor3", "ImageTransparency" }

local function IconProperties(ClassName: string, Properties: { [string]: any }): { [string]: any }
    if ClassName ~= "TextLabel" and ClassName ~= "TextButton" then
        return Properties
    end

    local Mapped: { [string]: any } = {}
    for Property, Value in Properties do
        Mapped[IconTextProperties[Property] or Property] = Value
    end

    return Mapped
end

local function IsFontIcon(Icon: Icon?, Size: UDim2?, Parent: Instance?): boolean
    if Icon == nil or Icon.FontFace == nil or Size == nil then
        return false
    end

    local Height = Size.Y.Offset
    if Size.Y.Scale ~= 0 then
        if not (Parent and Parent:IsA("GuiObject")) then
            return false
        end

        Height += Parent.AbsoluteSize.Y / Library.DPIScale * Size.Y.Scale
    end

    return Height > Library.MaxSpriteIconSize
end

local function ImageContent(Icon: Icon?): { [string]: any }
    return {
        Image = Icon and Icon.Url or "",
        ImageRectOffset = Icon and Icon.ImageRectOffset or Vector2.zero,
        ImageRectSize = Icon and Icon.ImageRectSize or Vector2.zero,
    }
end

local function SetIconProperties(Target: GuiObject, Properties: { [string]: any })
    FillInstance(IconProperties(Target.ClassName, Properties), Target)
end

local function TweenIcon(Target: GuiObject, Properties: { [string]: any }): Tween
    local Tween = TweenService:Create(Target, Library.TweenInfo, IconProperties(Target.ClassName, Properties))
    Tween:Play()

    return Tween
end

function Library:CreateIcon(Icon: Icon?, Properties: { [string]: any }?, IsButton: boolean?): GuiObject
    local IsFont = IsFontIcon(Icon, Properties and Properties.Size, Properties and Properties.Parent)
    local ClassName = (if IsFont then "Text" else "Image") .. (if IsButton then "Button" else "Label")

    local Merged: { [string]: any } = {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    }

    if not IsFont then
        Merged.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    end

    if Properties then
        for Property, Value in Properties do
            Merged[Property] = Value
        end
    end

    return Library:ApplyIcon(New(ClassName, IconProperties(ClassName, Merged)), Icon)
end

function Library:ApplyIcon(Target: GuiObject, Icon: Icon?): GuiObject
    local IsFont = IsFontIcon(Icon, Target.Size, Target.Parent)
    local IsText = Target:IsA("TextLabel") or Target:IsA("TextButton")

    if IsFont ~= IsText then
        local Theme = Library.Registry[Target] or {}
        local Properties: { [string]: any } = { Parent = Target.Parent }

        for _, Property in IconSharedProperties do
            local Source = if IsText then IconTextProperties[Property] or Property else Property
            Properties[Property] = if Theme[Source] ~= nil then Theme[Source] else (Target :: any)[Source]
        end

        local Replacement = Library:CreateIcon(Icon, Properties, Target:IsA("GuiButton"))
        Library:RemoveFromRegistry(Target)
        Target:Destroy()

        return Replacement
    end

    if IsFont and Icon then
        FillInstance({
            FontFace = Icon.FontFace,
            RichText = false,
            Text = Icon.Text,
            TextScaled = true,
        }, Target)

        if not Target:FindFirstChild("IconPadding") then
            New("UIPadding", {
                Name = "IconPadding",
                PaddingLeft = UDim.new(-0.5, 0),
                PaddingRight = UDim.new(-0.5, 0),
                Parent = Target,
            })
        end
    else
        FillInstance(ImageContent(Icon), Target)
    end

    return Target
end

--// DEPRECATED
function Library:ApplyLucideIcon(ImageGui: ImageLabel | ImageButton, Icon: Icon, Rotation: number?)
    warn("Obsidian:ApplyLucideIcon is deprecated, please use Obsidian:CreateIcon or Obsidian:ApplyIcon instead.")

    ImageGui.Rotation = Rotation or ImageGui.Rotation
    FillInstance(ImageContent(Icon), ImageGui)
end

--// Main Instances \\-
local function SafeParentUI(Instance: Instance, Parent: Instance | () -> Instance)
    local success, _error = pcall(function()
        if not Parent then
            Parent = CoreGui
        end

        local DestinationParent
        if typeof(Parent) == "function" then
            DestinationParent = Parent()
        else
            DestinationParent = Parent
        end

        Instance.Parent = DestinationParent
    end)

    if not (success and Instance.Parent) then
        Instance.Parent = Library.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", math.huge)
    end
end

local function ParentUI(UI: Instance, SkipHiddenUI: boolean?)
    if SkipHiddenUI then
        SafeParentUI(UI, CoreGui)
        return
    end

    pcall(protectgui, UI)
    SafeParentUI(UI, gethui)
end

local function SetAlwaysOnTop(Gui: ScreenGui, Enabled: boolean)
    if not Gui then
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        if sethiddenproperty then
            sethiddenproperty(Gui, "OnTopOfCoreBlur", Enabled)
        elseif setscriptable then
            setscriptable(Gui, "OnTopOfCoreBlur", true)
            Gui.OnTopOfCoreBlur = Enabled
            setscriptable(Gui, "OnTopOfCoreBlur", false)
        end
    end)
end

--// Lib Functions \\--
Library.Cursor = {}

function Library.Cursor:ResetCross()
    for _, Inner in InnerCross do
        Library.Registry[Inner].BackgroundColor3 = "WhiteColor"
        Inner.BackgroundColor3 = Library.Scheme.WhiteColor
    end
end

function Library.Cursor:ResetIcon()
    CursorCross.Visible = true
    CursorCustomImage.Visible = false
    CursorCustomImage.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
    SetIconProperties(CursorCustomImage, { ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
end

function Library.Cursor:ResetCursor()
    Library.Cursor:ResetCross()
    Library.Cursor:ResetIcon()
end

function Library.Cursor:ChangeCrossColor(Color: Color3)
    assert(typeof(Color) == "Color3", "Color3 expected.")
    for _, Inner in InnerCross do
        Inner.BackgroundColor3 = Color
        Library.Registry[Inner].BackgroundColor3 = nil
    end
end

function Library.Cursor:ChangeIcon(ImageId: string)
    if not ImageId or ImageId == "" then
        Library.Cursor:ResetIcon()
        return
    end

    local Icon = Library:GetCustomIcon(ImageId)
    assert(Icon, "Image must be a valid Roblox asset or a valid URL or a valid lucide icon.")

    CursorCross.Visible = false
    CursorCustomImage = Library:ApplyIcon(CursorCustomImage, Icon)
    CursorCustomImage.Visible = true
end

function Library.Cursor:ChangeIconColor(Color: Color3)
    assert(typeof(Color) == "Color3", "Color3 expected.")
    SetIconProperties(CursorCustomImage, { ImageColor3 = Color })
end

function Library.Cursor:ChangeIconSize(Size: UDim2)
    assert(typeof(Size) == "UDim2", "UDim2 expected.")
    CursorCustomImage.Size = Size
end
