		if ed76 then
			ed75 = ed76:GetPivot().Position
		end
	end)
	return ed75
end
function e5.travelToBiome(ed77)
	if e5.biomeTravelling then
		return
	end
	e5.biomeTravelling = true
	local ed78 = ed77 and e5.biomePoint(ed77)
	local ed79, ed7a = false, "pick a place first"
	if ed78 then
		pcall(function()
			ec70:Notify("Biome Travel: flying to " .. tostring(ed77), 4)
		end)
		local ed7b, ed7c, ed7d = pcall(e5.flyTo, ed78, function()
			return e5.BIOME_TRAVEL and not (e5.otherMoverOn and e5.otherMoverOn())
		end, 40)
		ed79, ed7a = ed7b and ed7c, ed7b and ed7d or tostring(ed7c)
	end
	pcall(function()
		ec70:Notify(
			ed79 and ("Arrived: " .. tostring(ed77))
				or ("Biome Travel: " .. tostring(ed7a) .. " - you are where it stopped"),
			6
		)
	end)
	e5.biomeTravelling = false
	e5.BIOME_TRAVEL = false
	if e5.biomeToggle then
		pcall(function()
			e5.biomeToggle:Set(false)
		end)
	end
end
e5.fossilFarmToggle = nil
local function ed7e(ed7f)
	local ed80 = ed7f:FindFirstChild("PumpkinPrompt", true)
	if ed80 and ed80:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return ed80 end
	for ed81, ed82 in ipairs(ed7f:GetDescendants()) do
		if ed82:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and ed82.Name == "Fossil" then
			return ed82
		end
	end
	return nil
end
function e5.fossilPosOf(ed83)
	local ed84, ed85 = pcall(function()
		local ed86 = ed7e(ed83)
		ed86 = ed86 and ed86.Parent
		if ed86 and ed86:IsA("Attachment") then
			return ed86.WorldPosition
		end
		if ed86 and ed86:IsA("BasePart") then
			return ed86.Position
		end
		return ed83:GetPivot().Position
	end)
	if ed84 then
		return ed85
	end
	return nil
end
function e5.ffPlanRoute(ed87)
local ed88, ed89 = os.clock(), {}
if e5.PUMPKIN_FARM then
for ed8a, ed8b in ipairs(e5.pumpkinsNow()) do
local ed8c = ed8b.Parent and ed7e(ed8b)
local ed8d = e5.ffSkip and e5.ffSkip[ed8b]
if ed8c and ed8c.Enabled ~= false and not (ed8d and ed8d > ed88) then
if e5.isGiantPumpkin(ed8b) then return { ed8b } end
local ed8e = e5.fossilPosOf(ed8b)
if ed8e and ed8e.Magnitude > 1 then ed89[#ed89 + 1] = { f = ed8b, p = ed8e } end
end
end
end
local ed8f = e5.FOSSIL_FARM and #ed89 == 0 and workspace:FindFirstChild("SpawnedFossils")
if ed8f then
for ed90, ed91 in ipairs(ed8f:GetChildren()) do
local ed92 = ed7e(ed91)
local ed93 = e5.ffSkip and e5.ffSkip[ed91]
if ed92 and ed92.Enabled ~= false and not (ed93 and ed93 > ed88) then
local ed94 = e5.fossilPosOf(ed91)
if ed94 and ed94.Magnitude > 1 then ed89[#ed89 + 1] = { f = ed91, p = ed94 } end
end
if #ed89 >= 150 then break end
end
end
local ed95 = #ed89
if ed95 == 0 then return {} end
local ed96, ed97, ed98 = {}, {}, ed87
for ed99 = 1, ed95 do
local ed9a, ed9b
for ed9c, ed9d in ipairs(ed89) do
if not ed97[ed9c] then
local ed9e = (ed9d.p - ed98).Magnitude
if not ed9b or ed9e < ed9b then ed9a, ed9b = ed9c, ed9e end
end
end
ed97[ed9a] = true
ed96[#ed96 + 1] = ed89[ed9a]
ed98 = ed89[ed9a].p
end
local function ed9f(eda0) return eda0 == 0 and ed87 or ed96[eda0].p end
for eda1 = 1, 8 do
local eda2 = false
for eda3 = 1, ed95 - 1 do
for eda4 = eda3 + 1, ed95 do
local eda5, eda6, eda7 = ed9f(eda3 - 1), ed9f(eda3), ed9f(eda4)
local eda8 = (eda6 - eda5).Magnitude
local eda9 = (eda7 - eda5).Magnitude
if eda4 < ed95 then
local edaa = ed9f(eda4 + 1)
eda8 = eda8 + (edaa - eda7).Magnitude
eda9 = eda9 + (edaa - eda6).Magnitude
end
if eda9 < eda8 - 0.01 then
local edab, edac = eda3, eda4
while edab < edac do ed96[edab], ed96[edac] = ed96[edac], ed96[edab]; edab, edac = edab + 1, edac - 1 end
eda2 = true
end
end
end
if not eda2 then break end
end
local edad = {}
for edae, edaf in ipairs(ed96) do edad[edae] = edaf.f end
return edad
end
function e5.nearestFossil(edb0)
	local edb1 = workspace:FindFirstChild("SpawnedFossils")
	if not edb1 then
		return nil
	end
	local edb2, edb3
	for edb4, edb5 in ipairs(edb1:GetChildren()) do
		local edb6 = ed7e(edb5)
		local edb7 = e5.ffSkip and e5.ffSkip[edb5]
		if edb6 and edb6.Enabled ~= false and not (edb7 and edb7 > os.clock()) then
			local edb8 = e5.fossilPosOf(edb5)
			if edb8 and edb8.Magnitude > 1 then
				local edb9 = (edb8 - edb0).Magnitude
				if not edb3 or edb9 < edb3 then
					edb2, edb3 = edb5, edb9
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return edb2
end
function e5.isolatePrompt(edba, edbb)
	local edbc = {}
	local edbd = workspace:FindFirstChild("SpawnedFossils")
	if not edbd then
		return edbc
	end
	for edbe, edbf in ipairs(edbd:GetChildren()) do
		local edc0 = ed7e(edbf)
		if edc0 and edc0 ~= edba and edc0.Enabled then
			local edc1, edc2 = pcall(function()
				return edc0.Parent.Position
			end)
			if (not edc1) or (edc2 - edbb).Magnitude < 80 then
				pcall(function()
					edc0.Enabled = false
				end)
				table.insert(edbc, edc0)
			end
		end
	end
	return edbc
end
function e5.restorePrompts(edc3)
	for edc4, edc5 in ipairs(edc3) do
		pcall(function()
			if edc5 and edc5.Parent then
				edc5.Enabled = true
			end
		end)
	end
end
function e5.autoSpawnCleanup()
	for edc6, edc7 in ipairs(e5.AUTO_SPAWN_DRAWS) do
		pcall(function()
			edc7:Remove()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(e5.AUTO_SPAWN_DRAWS)
	e5.AUTO_SPAWN = false
	e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET = nil
	e5.AUTO_SPAWN_GENDER = nil
	e5.AUTO_SPAWN_ATTEMPTS = 0
end
function e5.autoSpawnCleanupGUI()
	local edc8 = e3.PlayerGui
	pcall(function()
		local edc9 = edc8:FindFirstChild("DinosaurSelectionGui")
		if edc9 then
			edc9:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local edca = edc8:FindFirstChild("MainMenuGui")
		if edca then
			edca:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local edcb = edc8:FindFirstChild("LoadingGui")
		if edcb then
			edcb:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end
function e5.autoSpawnGetDinoName()
	local edcc = e3.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DinosaurSelectionGui")
	if not edcc then
		return nil
	end
	local edcd = edcc:FindFirstChild("TopFrame")
	if not edcd then
		return nil
	end
	local edce = edcd:FindFirstChild("Details")
	if not edce then
		return nil
	end
	local edcf = edce:FindFirstChild("DinosaurName")
	if edcf and edcf.Text ~= "" then
		return edcf.Text
	end
	return nil
end
function e5.autoSpawnGetGender()
	local edd0 = e3.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DinosaurSelectionGui")
	if not edd0 then
		return "Male"
	end
	local edd1, edd2 = pcall(function()
		local edd3 = edd0.LeftFrame.Customizer.Frame.Gender.Frame
		local edd4 = edd3:FindFirstChild("MaleButton")
		if edd4 then
			local edd5 = edd4:FindFirstChild("UIStroke")
			if edd5 and edd5.Color.G > 0.8 then
				return "Male"
			end
		end
		return "Female"
	end)
	return edd1 and edd2 or "Male"
end
function e5.autoSpawnIsAlive()
	local edd6 = e3.Character
	if not edd6 then
		return false
	end
	local edd7 = edd6:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return edd7 and edd7.Health > 0
end
function e5.startAutoSpawn()
	e5.autoSpawnCleanup()
	e5.AUTO_SPAWN = true
	e5.AUTO_SPAWN_ATTEMPTS = 0
	e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET = e5.autoSpawnGetDinoName()
	e5.AUTO_SPAWN_GENDER = e5.autoSpawnGetGender()
	if not e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET then
		pcall(function()
			ec70:Notify("Auto Spawn: open dino selection and pick a dino first", 5)
		end)
		e5.AUTO_SPAWN = false
		if e5.autoSpawnToggle then
			pcall(function()
				e5.autoSpawnToggle:Set(false)
			end)
		end
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		ec70:Notify(
			"Auto Spawn: locked on "
				.. e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET
				.. " ("
				.. e5.AUTO_SPAWN_GENDER
				.. ") \226\128\148 spamming RequestSlot",
			5
		)
	end)
	local edd8 = e5.AUTO_SPAWN_DRAWS
	local function edd9(edda)
		local eddb = e5.safeDraw("Text")
		eddb.Visible = true
		eddb.Color = edda.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		eddb.Size = edda.Size or (6553 - 6537)
		eddb.Position = edda.Position or Vector2.new(0, 0)
		eddb.Text = edda.Text or ""
		eddb.Font = 2
		eddb.Outline = true
		eddb.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		table.insert(edd8, eddb)
		return eddb
	end
	local function eddc(eddd)
		local edde = e5.safeDraw("Square")
		edde.Visible = true
		edde.Color = eddd.Color or Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
		edde.Size = eddd.Size or Vector2.new(100, 100)
		edde.Position = eddd.Position or Vector2.new(0, 0)
		edde.Filled = eddd.Filled ~= false
		edde.Transparency = eddd.Transparency or 0.3
		if eddd.Thickness then
			edde.Thickness = eddd.Thickness
		end
		table.insert(edd8, edde)
		return edde
	end
	local eddf, ede0 = 12, 12
	eddc({ Position = Vector2.new(eddf, ede0), Size = Vector2.new(300, 110) })
	local ede1 = eddc({
		Position = Vector2.new(eddf, ede0),
		Size = Vector2.new(300, 110),
		Filled = false,
		Transparency = 1,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 80),
		Thickness = 2,
	})
	local ede2 = edd9({
		Text = "AUTO-SPAWN [SPAM]",
		Position = Vector2.new(eddf + 6, ede0 + 4),
		Size = 18,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 80),
	})
	local ede3 = edd9({
		Text = "Target: " .. e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET .. " (LOCKED)",
		Position = Vector2.new(eddf + 6, ede0 + 26),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200),
	})
	local ede4 = edd9({ Text = "Slots: --/--", Position = Vector2.new(eddf + 6, ede0 + 44) })
	local ede5 = edd9({ Text = "Attempts: 0", Position = Vector2.new(eddf + 6, ede0 + 62) })
	local ede6 =
		edd9({ Text = "Starting...", Position = Vector2.new(eddf + 6, ede0 + 80), Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0) })
	local ede7 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local ede8 = e5.req(ede7:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Knit"))
	local ede9 = ede8.GetController("ApexController")
	local edea = ede8.GetService("CharacterService")
	task.spawn(function()
		while e5.AUTO_SPAWN and not e5.UNLOADED do
			pcall(function()
				local edeb = ede9:GetInfo(e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET)
				if edeb then
					ede4.Text = string.format(
						"Slots: %d/%d  (Zenith %d/%d)",
						edeb.UsedTotal or (-6432 + 6432),
						edeb.Slots or (5527 - 5527),
						edeb.UsedZenith or (731 - 731),
						edeb.ZenithSlots or (360 - 360)
					)
				end
			end)
			task.wait(3)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while e5.AUTO_SPAWN and not e5.UNLOADED do
			if e5.autoSpawnIsAlive() then
				e5.autoSpawnCleanupGUI()
				ede6.Text = "SPAWNED!"
				ede6.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				ede2.Text = "AUTO-SPAWN  SUCCESS"
				ede2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				ede1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				pcall(function()
					ec70:Notify("Auto Spawn: you're in! Stopping.", 4)
				end)
				task.wait(5)
				e5.autoSpawnCleanup()
				if e5.autoSpawnToggle then
					pcall(function()
						e5.autoSpawnToggle:Set(false)
					end)
				end
				return
			end
			if not e3.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DinosaurSelectionGui") then
				ede6.Text = "Not on selection screen \226\128\148 paused"
				ede6.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
				task.wait(1)
				continue
			end
			e5.AUTO_SPAWN_ATTEMPTS += 1
			ede5.Text = "Attempts: " .. e5.AUTO_SPAWN_ATTEMPTS
			local edec, eded, edee
			local edef = pcall(function()
				edec, eded, edee = ede9:RequestSlot(e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET)
			end)
			if not edef then
				ede6.Text = "Not apex \226\128\148 spawning direct"
				pcall(function()
					edea:InitiateSpawning({
						Species = e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET,
						Gender = e5.AUTO_SPAWN_GENDER,
						Skin = "Default",
						Variant = "Default",
					})
				end)
				e5.autoSpawnCleanupGUI()
				ede6.Text = "Spawn sent!"
				ede6.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
				ede2.Text = "AUTO-SPAWN  DONE"
				ede2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				ede1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				task.wait(5)
				e5.autoSpawnCleanup()
				if e5.autoSpawnToggle then
					pcall(function()
						e5.autoSpawnToggle:Set(false)
					end)
				end
				return
			end
			if edec then
				ede6.Text = "SLOT GRABBED! Spawning " .. e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET
				ede6.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				ede2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				ede1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				pcall(function()
					edea:InitiateSpawning({
						Species = e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET,
						Gender = e5.AUTO_SPAWN_GENDER,
						Skin = "Default",
						Variant = "Default",
					})
				end)
				e5.autoSpawnCleanupGUI()
				ede2.Text = "AUTO-SPAWN  SUCCESS"
				pcall(function()
					ec70:Notify("Auto Spawn: slot grabbed for " .. e5.AUTO_SPAWN_TARGET .. "!", 4)
				end)
				task.wait(5)
				e5.autoSpawnCleanup()
				if e5.autoSpawnToggle then
					pcall(function()
						e5.autoSpawnToggle:Set(false)
					end)
				end
				return
			end
			if eded == "Full" and edee then
				ede4.Text = string.format(
					"Slots: %d/%d  (Zenith %d/%d)",
					edee.UsedTotal or (-910 + 910),
					edee.Slots or (9157 - 9157),
					edee.UsedZenith or (3473 - 3473),
					edee.ZenithSlots or (-645 + 645)
				)
			end
			ede6.Text = "FULL \226\128\148 spamming..."
			ede6.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
			ede1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)
end
function e5.unanchorFarmRoot()
	local edf0 = e2d9()
	if edf0 then
		pcall(function()
			edf0.Anchored = false
		end)
	end
end
local edf1 = nil
local edf2 = {}
local function edf3()
	if edf1 then
		pcall(function()
			e5.VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, edf1, false, game)
		end)
		edf1 = nil
	end
	if #edf2 > 0 then
		e5.restorePrompts(edf2)
		edf2 = {}
	end
	e5.unanchorFarmRoot()
	if e5.fossilFarmCleanup then
		e5.fossilFarmCleanup()
	end
	if not (e5.NO_FALL_DAMAGE or e5.FOSSIL_FARM) then
		e5.applyFallImmunity(false)
	end
end
function e5.groundUnder(edf4)
	local edf5 = RaycastParams.new()
	edf5.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	edf5.FilterDescendantsInstances = { e3.Character }
	local edf6 = workspace:Raycast(edf4 + Vector3.new(0, 25, 0), Vector3.new(0, -300, 0), edf5)
	return edf6 and edf6.Position or nil
end

	function e5.fossilFarmAdvance(edf7)

if e5.ffState then
e5.fossilFarmCleanup()
local edf8 = e3.Character
if edf8 and not e5.AFK_FARM and not e5.LEGIT_FARM then pcall(function() edf8:SetAttribute("Teleporting", nil) end) end

end

e5.ffRoot = edf9

e5.CARRY_CORPSE = false
e5.CARRY_RANGE = 50
e5.carryOrig = nil
function e5.carryApply(ee4d)
	local function ee4e(ee4f)
		pcall(function()
			for ee50, ee51 in pairs(ee4f.ProximityPrompts or {}) do
				if typeof(ee51) == "Instance" and ee51:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					ee51.MaxActivationDistance = ee4f.Range
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if ee4d then
		if e5.carryOrig then
			return true
		end
		local ee52
		pcall(function()
			ee52 = e5.req(e3.PlayerScripts.Client.Classes.Character.Grab)
		end)
		if type(ee52) ~= "table" then
			return false
		end
		local ee53 = {}
		for ee54, ee55 in ipairs({ "GetGrabSettings", "MeetsWeightLimit", "IsDragDisabled", "Grab" }) do
			if type(ee52[ee55]) ~= "function" then
				return false
			end

		end
		local ee56
		pcall(function()
			ee56 = e5.req(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Consumption.GrabRules)
		end)
		if type(ee56) ~= "table" or type(ee56.Check) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		e5.carryOrig = { G = ee52, o = ee53 }
		local ee57 = ee56.Check
		e5.carryOrig.Rules, e5.carryOrig.rulesCheck = ee56, ee57
		ee56.Check = function(ee58, ee59, ee5a, ee5b)
			if not e5.CARRY_CORPSE or ee58 ~= "Drag" or type(ee5a) ~= "table" then
				return ee57(ee58, ee59, ee5a, ee5b)
			end
			local ee5c = table.clone(ee5a)
			                                                                       
			if type(ee5c.Weight) == "number" then
				ee5c.Weight = 0
			end
			if type(ee5c.Distance) == "number" and ee5c.Distance <= e5.CARRY_RANGE then
				ee5c.Reach = math.max(tonumber(ee5c.Reach) or 0, e5.CARRY_RANGE)
			end
			return ee57(ee58, ee59, ee5c, ee5b)
		end

		ee52.GetGrabSettings = function(ee5d, ...)
			local ee5e = ee53.GetGrabSettings(ee5d, ...)
			if type(ee5e) ~= "table" then
				return ee5e
			end
			local ee5f = table.clone(ee5e)
			ee5f.GrabLimit, ee5f.DragLimit = math.huge, math.huge
			ee5f.DragReverseLock, ee5f.DragDrain = false, 0
			return ee5f
		end

		ee52.MeetsWeightLimit = function(ee60, ee61, ee62, ...)
			if ee62 then
				return ee53.MeetsWeightLimit(ee60, ee61, ee62, ...)
			end
			return true
		end
		ee52.IsDragDisabled = function()
			return false
		end
		ee52.Grab = function(ee63, ee64, ee65, ...)
			if ee65 == "Meat" then
				return ee53.Grab(ee63, ee64, ee65, ...)
			end
			local ee66 = table.pack(pcall(ee53.Grab, ee63, ee64, ee65, ...))
			if not ee66[1] then
				error(ee66[2], 0)
			end
			return table.unpack(ee66, 2, ee66.n)
		end
		local ee67 = e5.getCC()
		if type(ee67) == "table" and type(ee67.GetConsumeRange) == "function" then
			local ee68 = ee67.GetConsumeRange
			e5.carryOrig.CC, e5.carryOrig.oRange = ee67, ee68
			ee67.GetConsumeRange = function(ee69, ...)
				return math.max(tonumber(ee68(ee69, ...)) or (-7429 + 7429), e5.CARRY_RANGE)
			end
			pcall(function()
				ee67.Range = ee67:GetConsumeRange()
			end)
			ee4e(ee67)
		end
		return true
	end
	local ee6a = e5.carryOrig
	if ee6a then
		if ee6a.Rules and ee6a.rulesCheck then
			ee6a.Rules.Check = ee6a.rulesCheck
		end
		for ee6b, ee6c in pairs(ee6a.o) do
			ee6a.G[ee6b] = ee6c
		end
		if ee6a.CC then
			ee6a.CC.GetConsumeRange = ee6a.oRange
			pcall(function()
				ee6a.CC.Range = ee6a.CC:GetConsumeRange()
			end)
			ee4e(ee6a.CC)
		end
		e5.carryOrig = nil
	end
	return true
end

					if not ee7b and not (e5.wallCross and e5.wallCross(ee6e, ee78)) then
						ee72, ee73, ee74 = ee75, ee77, ee79
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return ee72, ee73, ee74
end
function e5.warpToCorpse(ee7c, ee7d)
	local ee7e
	pcall(function()
		ee7e = ee7d:IsA("BasePart") and ee7d.Position or ee7d:GetPivot().Position
	end)
	if not ee7e then
		return false
	end
	local ee7f = ee7e + Vector3.new(e5.TP_OFFSET or (7170 - 7162), 0, 0)
	local ee80 = e5.flyTo(ee7f, function()
		return e5.TP_CORPSE and not (e5.otherMoverOn and e5.otherMoverOn())
	end, 40)
	return ee80
		and ee7c.Parent ~= nil
		and Vector3.new(ee7c.Position.X - ee7e.X, 0, ee7c.Position.Z - ee7e.Z).Magnitude < 40
end
e5.addStep(30, function()
	if e5.UNLOADED or not e5.TP_CORPSE or e5.tpBusy then
		return
	end
	if e5.tpDone and not e5.TP_CHAIN then
		return
	end
	if
		e5.FLY
		or e5.AUTO_FLY
		or e5.AFK_FARM
		or e5.LEGIT_FARM
		or e5.FOSSIL_FARM
		or e5.SAVE_DINO_ACTIVE
		or e5.BIOME_TRAVEL
	then
		return
	end
	local ee81 = e2d9()
	if not (ee81 and ee81.Parent) then
		return
	end
	local ee82 = e5.getCC()
	if not ee82 then
		return
	end
	if e5.tpTargetId then
		local ee83 = ee82.CorpseData and ee82.CorpseData[e5.tpTargetId]
		if ee83 and (tonumber(ee83.Weight) or (-4606 + 4606)) > 0 then
			return
		end
		e5.tpTargetId = nil
		if not e5.TP_CHAIN then
			e5.tpDone = true
			return
		end
	end
	local ee84, ee85, ee86 = e5.nearestCorpse(ee81.Position)
	if not ee84 then
		if not e5.tpNoneSaid then
			e5.tpNoneSaid = true
			pcall(function()
				ec70:Notify("Teleport to Corpse: no corpse with meat you can reach - waiting for one", 5)
			end)
		end
		return
	end
	e5.tpNoneSaid = nil
	e5.tpBusy = true
	task.spawn(function()
		e5.applyFallImmunity(true)
		pcall(function()
			ec70:Notify(
				"Teleport to Corpse: flying to a corpse " .. math.floor(ee86 or (3315 - 3315)) .. " studs away",
				4
			)
		end)
		local ee87 = e5.warpToCorpse(ee81, ee85)
		e5.tpTargetId = ee87 and ee84 or nil
		if ee87 and not e5.TP_CHAIN then
			e5.tpDone = true
		end
		pcall(function()
			ec70:Notify(
				ee87 and "Teleport to Corpse: at the corpse"
					or ("Teleport to Corpse: " .. (e5.TP_CORPSE and "could not reach it" or "stopped")),
				5
			)
		end)
		task.delay(6, function()
			if not (e5.NO_FALL_DAMAGE or e5.FOSSIL_FARM or e5.TP_CORPSE) then
				e5.applyFallImmunity(false)
			end
		end)
		e5.tpBusy = false
	end)
end)
e5.FPS_SAVER = false
do
	local ee88 = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local ee89 = game:GetService("RunService")
	local ee8a
	function e5.applyFpsSaver(ee8b)
		if ee8b then
			if not ee8a then
				ee8a = {
					shadows = ee88.GlobalShadows,
					fogEnd = ee88.FogEnd,
					fogStart = ee88.FogStart,
					quality = nil,
					effects = {},
				}
				pcall(function()
					ee8a.quality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel
				end)
				for ee8c, ee8d in ipairs(ee88:GetChildren()) do
					if ee8d:IsA("PostEffect") or ee8d:IsA("BlurEffect") then
						ee8a.effects[ee8d] = ee8d.Enabled
					end
				end
			end
			pcall(function()
				if setfpscap and not e5.IS_XENO then
					setfpscap(10)
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
			end)
			pcall(function()
				ee88.GlobalShadows = false
			end)
			pcall(function()
				ee88.FogStart = 0
				ee88.FogEnd = 12
			end)
			for ee8e, ee8f in ipairs(ee88:GetChildren()) do
				if ee8f:IsA("PostEffect") or ee8f:IsA("BlurEffect") then
					pcall(function()
						ee8f.Enabled = false
					end)
				end
			end
			pcall(function()
				ee89:Set3dRenderingEnabled(false)
			end)
		else
			pcall(function()
				ee89:Set3dRenderingEnabled(true)
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if setfpscap and not e5.IS_XENO then
					setfpscap(0)
				end
			end)
			if ee8a then
				pcall(function()
					if ee8a.quality then
						settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = ee8a.quality
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					ee88.GlobalShadows = ee8a.shadows
				end)
				pcall(function()
					ee88.FogStart = ee8a.fogStart
					ee88.FogEnd = ee8a.fogEnd
				end)
				for ee90, ee91 in pairs(ee8a.effects) do
					pcall(function()
						if ee90 and ee90.Parent then
							ee90.Enabled = ee91
						end
					end)
				end
				ee8a = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function e5.markScaled(eecf, eed0, eed1)
	local eed2 = (tonumber(eed1) or (-3269 + 3270)) >= 5
	for eed3, eed4 in ipairs({ eecf, eed0 }) do
		if eed4 and eed4.SetSkull then
			pcall(function()
				eed4:SetSkull(eed2)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function e5.moversOff(eee8)
	for eee9, eeea in pairs({
		pumpkinFarmToggle = "PUMPKIN_FARM",
		flyToggle = "FLY",
		autoFlyToggle = "AUTO_FLY",
		tpCorpseToggle = "TP_CORPSE",
		biomeToggle = "BIOME_TRAVEL",
		fossilFarmToggle = "FOSSIL_FARM",
		afkFarmToggle = "AFK_FARM",
		legitFarmToggle = "LEGIT_FARM",
	}) do
		local eeeb = e5[eee9]
		if eee9 ~= eee8 and e5[eeea] and eeeb and eeeb.Set then
			pcall(function()
				eeeb:Set(false)
			end)
		end
	end
end
function e5.otherMoverOn()
	return e5.PUMPKIN_FARM
		or e5.FLY
		or e5.AUTO_FLY
		or e5.AFK_FARM
		or e5.LEGIT_FARM
		or e5.FOSSIL_FARM
		or e5.SAVE_DINO_ACTIVE
		or false
end

e5.biomeToggle = ee97:AddToggle({
	Name = "Biome Travel",
	Skull = true,
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(eef0)
		if not eef0 then
			e5.BIOME_TRAVEL = false
			return
		end
		if not e5.BIOME_TARGET then
			pcall(function()
				ec70:Notify("Biome Travel: pick a Destination first", 4)
			end)
			task.defer(function()
				pcall(function()
					e5.biomeToggle:Set(false)
				end)
			end)
			return
		end
		if e5.BIOME_TRAVEL then
			return
		end
		e5.moversOff("biomeToggle")
		e5.BIOME_TRAVEL = true
		task.spawn(e5.travelToBiome, e5.BIOME_TARGET)
	end,
})

			if type(ef03) == "table" then

		end,
	})

e5.section(
	ee97,
	"Admin Detection",
	"Mod Check: warns you when a game admin joins your server. It checks their group rank, so an alt account still sets it off.\010Auto Leave: disconnects you automatically as soon as one is detected."
)
ee96.modCheck = ee97:AddToggle({
	Name = "Mod Check",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(ef68)
		e5.MOD_CHECK = ef68
		e5.modCheckRefresh()
	end,
})
ee96.modKick = ee97:AddToggle({
	Name = "Auto Leave",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(ef69)
		e5.MOD_KICK = ef69
	end,
})
do
	e5.modAdmins = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	e5.modGroupId = nil
	e5.modAlertGui = nil
	e5.modAlertFrame = nil
	e5.modAlertLabels = {}
	local function ef6a()
		if e5.modGroupId then
			return e5.modGroupId
		end
		local ef6b, ef6c = pcall(function()
			return game.CreatorType
		end)
		if ef6b and ef6c == Enum.CreatorType.Group then
			e5.modGroupId = game.CreatorId
		else
			e5.modGroupId = game.CreatorId
		end
		return e5.modGroupId
	end
	local function ef6d(ef6e)
		local ef6f = ef6a()
		if not ef6f or ef6f == 0 then
			return false
		end
		local ef70, ef71 = pcall(function()
			return ef6e:GetRoleInGroup(ef6f)
		end)
		if not ef70 or type(ef71) ~= "string" then
			return false
		end
		local ef72 = string.lower(ef71)
		for ef73, ef74 in ipairs(e5.MOD_ADMIN_KEYWORDS) do
			if string.find(ef72, ef74, 1, true) then
				return true, ef71
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	local function ef75()
		if e5.modAlertGui and e5.modAlertGui.Parent then
			return
		end
		local ef76 = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		ef76.Name = "ECLIPSEModAlert"
		ef76.ResetOnSpawn = false
		ef76.DisplayOrder = 99999
		ef76.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
		pcall(function()
			ef76.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
		end)
		if not ef76.Parent then
			ef76.Parent = e3:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		end
		e5.modAlertGui = ef76
		local ef77 = Instance.new("Frame")
		ef77.Name = "AdminList"
		ef77.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 300)
		ef77.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
		ef77.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ef77.Parent = ef76
		local ef78 = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		ef78.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
		ef78.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
		ef78.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		ef78.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
		ef78.Parent = ef77
		e5.modAlertFrame = ef77
	end
	local function ef79()
		if not e5.modAlertFrame then
			return
		end
		for ef7a, ef7b in pairs(e5.modAlertLabels) do
			pcall(function()
				ef7b:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		e5.modAlertLabels = {}
		if not e5.MOD_CHECK then
			if e5.modAlertGui then
				e5.modAlertGui.Enabled = false
			end
			return
		end
		local ef7c = 0
		for ef7d, ef7e in pairs(e5.modAdmins) do
			if ef7d and ef7d.Parent then
				ef7c = ef7c + 1
				local ef7f = (type(ef7e) == "string") and string.upper(ef7e) or "ADMIN"
				local ef80 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				ef80.Name = "Admin_" .. ef7d.Name
				ef80.LayoutOrder = ef7c
				ef80.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
				ef80.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
				ef80.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
				ef80.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
				ef80.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
				ef80.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				ef80.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				ef80.TextSize = 15
				ef80.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				ef80.Text = ef7f .. ": " .. ef7d.DisplayName .. " (@" .. ef7d.Name .. ")"
				Instance.new("UICorner", ef80).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
				ef80.Parent = e5.modAlertFrame
				e5.modAlertLabels[ef7d] = ef80
			end
		end
		if e5.modAlertGui then
			e5.modAlertGui.Enabled = ef7c > 0
		end
	end
	local function ef81(ef82)
		if ef82 == e3 then
			return
		end
		if e5.UNLOADED then
			return
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local ef83, ef84 = ef6d(ef82)
			if ef83 then
				e5.modAdmins[ef82] = ef84 or "Admin"
				if e5.MOD_KICK or (e5.AFK_FARM and e5.AFK_FARM_ADMIN_KICK) or (e5.LEGIT_FARM and e5.LF_ADMIN_KICK) then
					if not (e5.rejoinLeave and e5.rejoinLeave("admin in the server: " .. ef82.DisplayName)) then
						pcall(e5.leaveNote, "admin detected", false)
						pcall(function()
							e3:Kick("[ECLIPSE] Admin detected: " .. ef82.DisplayName)
						end)
					end
					return
				end
				if e5.MOD_CHECK then
					ef75()
					ef79()
					pcall(function()
						ec70:Notify(
							string.upper(ef84 or "ADMIN") .. ": " .. ef82.DisplayName .. " (@" .. ef82.Name .. ")",
							8
						)
					end)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	function e5.adminKickSweep()
		for ef85, ef86 in ipairs(e1:GetPlayers()) do
			ef81(ef86)
		end
	end
	function e5.modCheckRefresh()
		if e5.MOD_CHECK then
			ef75()
			for ef87, ef88 in ipairs(e1:GetPlayers()) do
				if not e5.modAdmins[ef88] then
					ef81(ef88)
				end
			end
			ef79()
		else
			ef79()
		end
	end
	table.insert(
		e50,
		e1.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(ef89)
			if
				e5.MOD_CHECK
				or e5.MOD_KICK
				or (e5.AFK_FARM and e5.AFK_FARM_ADMIN_KICK)
				or (e5.LEGIT_FARM and e5.LF_ADMIN_KICK)
			then
				ef81(ef89)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		e50,
		e1.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(ef8a)
			if e5.modAdmins[ef8a] then
				e5.modAdmins[ef8a] = nil
				ef79()
			end
		end)
	)
	function e5.cleanupModCheck()
		e5.modAdmins = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		if e5.modAlertGui then
			pcall(function()
				e5.modAlertGui:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		e5.modAlertGui = nil
		e5.modAlertFrame = nil
		e5.modAlertLabels = {}
	end
end
function e5.unloadScript()
	e5.PUMPKIN_COLLECT_RANGE_ENABLED = false
	e5.restorePumpkinPrompts()
	e5.UNLOADED = true
	e5.stopPumpkinFarm()
	e5.PUMPKIN_ESP = false
	e5.clearPumpkinESP()
	pcall(function()
		e5.CARRY_CORPSE = false
		e5.carryApply(false)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		if e5.lfRestoreInput then
			e5.lfRestoreInput()
		end
	end)
	e5.AUTO_GAIT = nil
	pcall(function()
		if e5.autoGaitStop then
			e5.autoGaitStop()
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		if e5.mvCleanup then
			e5.mvCleanup()
		end
	end)
	pcall(e5.sweepOwnGuis)
	e5.MOD_CHECK = false
	e5.MOD_KICK = false
	e5.cleanupModCheck()
	e5.FULLBRIGHT = false
	pcall(function()
		e2:UnbindFromRenderStep("PX_Fullbright")
	end)
	pcall(function()
		if e5.restoreFullbright then
			e5.restoreFullbright()
		end
	end)
	e5.AFK_FARM = false
	e5.afkStopWalk()
	if e5.afkColliders then
		for ef8b in pairs(e5.afkColliders) do
			if ef8b.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					ef8b.CanCollide = true
				end)
			end
		end
		e5.afkColliders, e5.afkCollidersChar = nil, nil
	end
	if e5.afkWasOn then
		e5.afkWasOn = false
		pcall(function()
			e3.Character:SetAttribute("Teleporting", nil)
		end)
	end
	if e5.afkSafetyState then
		if e5.afkSafetyState == "resting" then
			e5.pressRest()
		end
		if e5.afkSafetyPlatform then
			pcall(function()
				e5.afkSafetyPlatform:Destroy()
			end)
			e5.afkSafetyPlatform = nil
		end
		pcall(function()
			local ef8c = e5.getLocalPhysicsRoot()
			if ef8c then
				ef8c.Anchored = false
			end
		end)
		e5.afkSafetyState = nil
	end
	e5.AUTO_SWITCH, e5.AS_BUSY, e5.FARM_TIMER = false, false, false
	e5.LEGIT_FARM = false
	pcall(function()
		e2:UnbindFromRenderStep("PX_LegitSteer")
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local ef8d = e5.lfWalkState
		if ef8d then
			ef8d.mod.AdjustDirection = ef8d.orig
			e5.lfWalkState = nil
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		if e5.lfWasOn and e5.lfStop then
			e5.lfStop(false)
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local ef8e = getgenv and getgenv().ECLIPSE_Handoff
		if e5.REJOIN_OK and e5.REJOIN and not ef8e then
			local ef8f = e5.rejoinRead()
			ef8f.farms, ef8f.pending = {}, nil
			e5.rejoinWrite(ef8f)
		end
	end)
	e5.NO_FOG = false
	pcall(function()
		e2:UnbindFromRenderStep("PX_NoFog")
	end)
	pcall(function()
		if e5.restoreNoFog then
			e5.restoreNoFog()
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(e5.setCustomTime, false)
	end)
	e5.customTime = false
	pcall(function()
		e2:UnbindFromRenderStep("PX_CustomTime")
	end)
	e5.autoSpawnCleanup()
	e5.stopAutoGrow()
	if e5.FPS_SAVER then
		e5.FPS_SAVER = false
		pcall(function()
			if e5.applyFpsSaver then
				e5.applyFpsSaver(false)
			end
		end)
	end
	e5.ESP_ENABLED = false
	e5.CHAMS_ENABLED = false
	e5.TRACERS_ENABLED = false
	e5.CORPSE_ESP = false
	e5.FOSSIL_SMALL = false
	e5.FOSSIL_MEDIUM = false
	e5.FOSSIL_LARGE = false
	e5.MEAT_ESP = false
	e5.CLAY_ESP = false
	e5.VEG_ESP = false
	pcall(function()
		if e5.vegFolder then
			e5.vegFolder:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	e5.vegFolder = nil
	e5.vegPool = {}
	e5.HITBOX_EXPANDER = false
	e5.HITBOX_VISUALIZE = false
	e5.resetAllHitboxes()
	e5.REACH_ENABLED = false
	e5.resetLocalReach()
	pcall(function()
		for ef90 in pairs(e5.hbMaskT or {}) do
			if ef90 and ef90.Parent then
				ef90.CanQuery = true
			end
		end
		e5.hbMaskT = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	end)
	e5.AUTO_WATER = false
	e5.NO_ATK_CD = false
	e5.NO_ATK_COOLDOWN = false
	e5.restoreAttackSpeed()
	e5.UNLIMITED_ZOOM = false
	e5.restoreZoom()
	e5.FOV_ENABLED = false
	e5.restoreFOV()
	e5.BIOME_TRAVEL = false
	e5.NO_BLUR = false
	pcall(e5.restoreBlur)
	if e5.NO_WEATHER then
		e5.NO_WEATHER = false
		pcall(function()
			e5.applyNoWeather(false)
		end)
	end
	e5.SAVE_DINO_ACTIVE = false
	eca4()
	ec98()
	for ef91, ef92 in pairs(e5.espCache) do
		e5.destroyESP(ef91)
	end
	for ef93, ef94 in pairs(eeb) do
		pcall(function()
			ef94:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	eeb = {}
	for ef95, ef96 in ipairs(e50) do
		pcall(function()
			ef96:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	e50 = {}
	pcall(function()
		if e5.mobGui then
			e5.mobGui:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		e5.mmapDestroyPool()
	end)
	pcall(function()
		ec70:Destroy()
	end)
	pcall(function()
		indicatorGui:Destroy()
	end)
	pcall(e5.sweepOwnGuis)
	pcall(function()
		for ef97, ef98 in workspace:GetChildren() do
			if ef98.Name == "ECLIPSECircle" or ef98.Name == "ECLIPSEPath" then
				ef98:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		for ef99, ef9a in ipairs({
			"PX_CustomTime",
			"PX_Fullbright",
			"PX_NoFog",
			"ECLIPSE_UnlimitedZoom",
			"ECLIPSE_UnlimitedZoomFix",
			"PX_FossilCam",
		}) do
			pcall(function()
				e2:UnbindFromRenderStep(ef9a)
			end)
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local ef9b = getgenv and getgenv()
		if ef9b then
			ef9b.ECLIPSE_Unload = nil
		end
	end)
end
pcall(function()
	local ef9c = getgenv and getgenv()
	if ef9c then
		ef9c.ECLIPSE_Unload = e5.unloadScript
		ef9c.ECLIPSE_Unload_Job = game.JobId
		ef9c.ECLIPSE_Unload_State = nil
	end
end)

function e5.applyConfigData(efa1)
	e5.SUPPRESS_TOGGLE_NOTIFY = true
	local efa2, efa3 = pcall(e5.applyConfigBody, efa1)
	if not efa2 then
		warn("[ECLIPSE] Config apply error: " .. tostring(efa3))
	end
	e5.freeLock()
	e5.SUPPRESS_TOGGLE_NOTIFY = false
	e5.cfgApplied = true
	return efa2
end
function e5.applyConfigBody(efa4)
	for efa5, efa6 in pairs(e5.FARM_MODE_KEYS) do
		local efa7 = efa4[efa6]
		if efa7 and e5.setFarmTravelMode(efa5, efa7) then
			local efa8 = e5.farmModeControls and e5.farmModeControls[efa5]
			if efa8 then efa8:Set(efa7, true) end
		end
	end
	e5.SUPPRESS_TOGGLE_NOTIFY = true
	local function efa9(efaa, efab)
		pcall(function()
			if efaa and efab ~= nil then
				efaa:Set(efab)
			end
		end)
	end
	local function efac(efad, efae)
		pcall(function()
			if efad and efae ~= nil then
				efad:Set(efae)
			end
		end)
	end
	local function efaf(efb0, efb1, efb2, efb3, efb4)
		pcall(function()
			for efb5, efb6 in ipairs(efb1) do
				local efb7 = efb2[efb3 .. efb6]
				if efb7 ~= nil then
					efb0[efb6] = efb7 and true or false
				end
			end
			if efb4 and efb4.Refill then
				efb4.Refill()
			end
		end)
	end
	efa9(e5.espToggle, efa4.ESP_ENABLED)
	efa9(ee96.chams, efa4.CHAMS_ENABLED)
	efa9(ee96.tracers, efa4.TRACERS_ENABLED)
	efa9(ee96.showName, efa4.SHOW_NAME)
	efa9(ee96.showDino, efa4.SHOW_DINO)
	efa9(ee96.showStage, efa4.SHOW_STAGE)
	efa9(ee96.showGender, efa4.SHOW_GENDER)
	efa9(ee96.showHealth, efa4.SHOW_HEALTH)
	efa9(ee96.showStamina, efa4.SHOW_STAMINA)
	if efa4.SHOW_FOOD_BAR ~= nil then
		efa9(ee96.foodBar, efa4.SHOW_FOOD_BAR)
	end
	if efa4.SHOW_FOOD_NUM ~= nil then
		efa9(ee96.foodNum, efa4.SHOW_FOOD_NUM)
	end
	if efa4.SHOW_WATER_BAR ~= nil then
		efa9(ee96.waterBar, efa4.SHOW_WATER_BAR)
	end
	if efa4.SHOW_WATER_NUM ~= nil then
		efa9(ee96.waterNum, efa4.SHOW_WATER_NUM)
	end
	if efa4.SHOW_INFECT_BAR ~= nil then
		efa9(ee96.infectBar, efa4.SHOW_INFECT_BAR)
	end
	if efa4.SHOW_INFECT_NUM ~= nil then
		efa9(ee96.infectNum, efa4.SHOW_INFECT_NUM)
	end
	if efa4.SHOW_INFECTED ~= nil then

	end
	efa9(ee96.showWeight, efa4.SHOW_WEIGHT)
	efa9(ee96.bleed, efa4.BLEED_ESP)
	if efa4.PACK_ESP ~= nil then
		efa9(ee96.packESP, efa4.PACK_ESP)
	end
	if efa4.PACK_LEADER_ESP ~= nil then
		efa9(ee96.packLeader, efa4.PACK_LEADER_ESP)
	end
	efa9(ee96.showDist, efa4.SHOW_DISTANCE)
	efa9(ee96.textHL, efa4.TEXT_HIGHLIGHT)
	efac(ee96.textSize, efa4.TEXT_SIZE)
	efac(ee96.hbHeight, efa4.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT)
	if efa4.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH then
		efac(ee96.hbWidth, math.floor(efa4.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH * 100 + 0.5))
	end
	if efa4.STAM_BAR_HEIGHT then
		efac(ee96.sbHeight, efa4.STAM_BAR_HEIGHT)
	end
	if efa4.STAM_BAR_WIDTH then
		efac(ee96.sbWidth, math.floor(efa4.STAM_BAR_WIDTH * 100 + 0.5))
	end
	efac(ee96.espDist, efa4.ESP_DISTANCE)
	if efa4.CHAMS_FILL_TRANSPARENCY then

	if efa4.CHAMS_OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY then
		efac(ee96.chamsOutline, math.floor(efa4.CHAMS_OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY * 100 + 0.5))

	efa9(ee96.corpse, efa4.CORPSE_ESP)
	if efa4.CORPSE_INF_ESP ~= nil then

		e5.setStatsCardPos(efa4.SC_POS_XS, efa4.SC_POS_XO, efa4.SC_POS_YS, efa4.SC_POS_YO)

	if efa4.PUMPKIN_ESP ~= nil then

function e5.listConfigs()
	local efc8 = {}
	pcall(function()
		local efc9 = listfiles(e5.CONFIG_FOLDER)
		for efca, efcb in ipairs(efc9) do
			local efcc = efcb:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
			if efcc and efcc ~= "autoload" then
				table.insert(efc8, efcc)
			end
		end
	end)
	table.sort(efc8)
	return efc8
end
function e5.saveConfig(efcd)
	local efce, efcf = pcall(function()
		local efd0 = e5.getConfigData()
		writefile(e5.CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. efcd .. ".json", ef9d:JSONEncode(efd0))
	end)
	if efce then
		print("[ECLIPSE] Config saved: " .. efcd)
		pcall(function()
			ec70:Notify("Saved config: " .. efcd)
		end)
	else
		warn("[ECLIPSE] Config save FAILED: " .. tostring(efcf))
		pcall(function()
			ec70:Notify("Save failed: " .. efcd)
		end)
	end
	return efce
end
function e5.loadConfig(efd1)
	local efd2, efd3 = pcall(function()
		local efd4 = readfile(e5.CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. efd1 .. ".json")
		return ef9d:JSONDecode(efd4)
	end)
	if efd2 and efd3 then
		e5.applyConfigData(efd3)
		print("[ECLIPSE] Config loaded: " .. efd1)
		pcall(function()
			ec70:Notify("Loaded config: " .. efd1)
		end)
		return true
	else
		warn("[ECLIPSE] Config load FAILED: " .. tostring(efd3))
		pcall(function()
			ec70:Notify("Load failed: " .. efd1)
		end)
	end
	return false
end
function e5.deleteConfig(efd5)
	pcall(function()
		delfile(e5.CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. efd5 .. ".json")
	end)
end
function e5.getAutoLoadConfig()
	local efd6, efd7 = pcall(function()
		return readfile(e5.AUTO_LOAD_FILE)
	end)
	if efd6 and efd7 and efd7 ~= "" then
		return efd7
	end
	return nil
end
function e5.setAutoLoadConfig(efd8)
	pcall(function()
		writefile(e5.AUTO_LOAD_FILE, efd8 or "")
	end)
end

function e5.createIndicatorLabel(efe3, efe4)
	local efe5 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	efe5.Name = "Ind_" .. efe3
	efe5.LayoutOrder = efe4
	efe5.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
	efe5.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	efe5.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 90, 255)
	efe5.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	efe5.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	efe5.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	efe5.TextSize = 13
	efe5.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	efe5.Text = efe3
	efe5.TextTransparency = 1
	efe5.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	efe5.Parent = efe0
	efe2[efe3] = efe5
	return efe5
end
function e5.showIndicator(efe6)
	local efe7 = efe2[efe6]
	if not efe7 then
		return
	end
	efe7.Visible = true
	efe7.TextTransparency = 1
	efe7.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	local efe8 = e5.TweenService:Create(
		efe7,
		TweenInfo.new(e5.SLIDE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ TextTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) }
	)
	efe8:Play()
end
function e5.hideIndicator(efe9)
	local efea = efe2[efe9]
	if not efea then
		return
	end
	local efeb = e5.TweenService:Create(
		efea,
		TweenInfo.new(e5.SLIDE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
		{ TextTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) }
	)
	efeb:Play()
	efeb.Completed:Connect(function()
		if efea.TextTransparency >= 0.9 then
			efea.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end
function e5.updateIndicator(efec, efed)
	if efed then
		e5.showIndicator(efec)
	else
		e5.hideIndicator(efec)
	end
end

e5.FARM_STOP_MODE = e5.FARM_STOP_MODE or "Land nearby"
local function e102c()
 return e5.AFK_FARM or e5.LEGIT_FARM or e5.FOSSIL_FARM or e5.PUMPKIN_FARM or e5.FLY or e5.AUTO_FLY or e5.SAVE_DINO_ACTIVE
end
function e5.cancelFarmStop()
 local e102d = e5.farmStopJob
 e5.farmStopJob = nil
 if e102d and e102d.character.Parent then
  pcall(function()
   if e102d.character:GetAttribute("Teleporting") == e102d.y then e102d.character:SetAttribute("Teleporting", nil) end
  end)
 end
end
function e5.beginFarmStop()
 if e5.UNLOADED or e5.farmStopJob then return end
 local e102e, e102f = e5.getLocalPhysicsRoot(), e3.Character
 if not e102e or not e102f or (e102f:GetAttribute("Health") or 1) <= 0 then return end
 local e1030 = {root=e102e,character=e102f,position=e102e.Position,y=e102e.Position.Y,phase="waiting",start=os.clock()}
 e5.farmStopJob = e1030
 task.defer(function()
  if e5.farmStopJob ~= e1030 then return end
  if e102c() then e5.cancelFarmStop(); return end
  if e5.FARM_STOP_MODE == "Water" then
   e1030.phase = "searching"
   e1030.searchAt = os.clock()
   e5.drinkSpot = nil
   e5.drinkFind(e102e.Position, e5.DRINK_SEARCH or 1500, e5.AFK_FARM_AVOID or 200)
  else e1030.phase = "planning" end
 end)
end
local function e1031(e1032)
 pcall(function() e5.Hub:Notify(e1032, 8) end)
end
local function e1033(e1034, e1035)
 local e1036 = e5.ffRayParams()
 e1036.IgnoreWater = e1035
 return workspace:Raycast(e1034 + Vector3.new(0,400,0), Vector3.new(0,-1600,0), e1036)
end
local function e1037(e1038, e1039, e103a)
 local e103b = e1033(e1039, false)
 if not e103b or (e103a and e103b.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water) then return false end
 if e103a then
  local e103c = e1033(e1039, true)
  if not e103c or e103b.Position.Y - e103c.Position.Y < math.max(e1038.root.Size.Y, e5.ugRideHeight()) + 2 then return false end
 end
 local e103d = Vector3.new(e1039.X, e103b.Position.Y + e1038.root.Size.Y * 0.5, e1039.Z)
 local e103e = e103d - e1038.position
 local e103f = Vector3.new(e103e.X,0,e103e.Z).Magnitude
 local e1040 = math.max(e1038.position.Y, e103d.Y)
 local e1041 = math.clamp(math.ceil(e103f / 20),1,100)
 for e1042=0,e1041 do
  local e1043 = e1033(e1038.position:Lerp(e103d,e1042/e1041), false)
  if not e1043 then return false end
  e1040 = math.max(e1040,e1043.Position.Y + e5.ugRideHeight() + 3)
 end
 if e103f < 2 then e1038.legs={e103d}
 else e1038.legs={Vector3.new(e1038.position.X,e1040,e1038.position.Z),Vector3.new(e103d.X,e1040,e103d.Z),e103d} end
 e1038.index,e1038.phase,e1038.routeStart = 1,"travelling",os.clock()
 return true
end
table.insert(e50, e2.Heartbeat:Connect(function(e1044)
 local e1045=e5.farmStopJob
 if not e1045 then return end
 if e5.UNLOADED or e102c() or e3.Character ~= e1045.character or not e1045.root.Parent or (e1045.character:GetAttribute("Health") or 1)<=0 then
  e5.cancelFarmStop();return
 end
 if e1045.phase=="searching" then
  local e1046=e5.drinkSpot
  if e1046 and e1046.t >= e1045.searchAt then
   e5.drinkSpot=nil
   if not e1046.water or not e1037(e1045,e1046.water,true) then
    e1045.phase="holding";e1031("No suitable deep-water route found. Holding here; use Land Here or Release Hover.")
   end
  elseif os.clock()-e1045.searchAt>10 then
   e1045.phase="holding";e1031("Water search timed out. Holding here; use Land Here or Release Hover.")
  end
 elseif e1045.phase=="planning" then
  if not e1037(e1045,e1045.position,false) then e1045.phase="holding";e1031("Ground not loaded. Holding here.") end
 elseif e1045.phase=="travelling" then
  local e1047=e1045.legs[e1045.index]
  if os.clock()-e1045.routeStart>120 then e1045.phase="holding";e1031("Landing route timed out. Holding here.")
  else
   local e1048=e1045.root.Position
   if (e1048-e1045.position).Magnitude>8 then
    e1045.position=e1048;e1045.phase="holding";e1031("Landing interrupted by a position correction. Holding here.")
   else
    local e1049=e5.govNext(e1045.position,e1047,math.min(e1044,0.1),e1045.index==#e1045.legs and 6 or nil)
    local e104a=e5.ffRayParams()
    local e104b=workspace:Raycast(e1045.position,e1049-e1045.position,e104a)
    if e104b then e1045.phase="holding";e1031("Landing route blocked. Holding here.")
    else e1045.position=e1049 end
    if (e1045.position-e1047).Magnitude<0.4 then
     if e1045.index<#e1045.legs then e1045.index+=1
     else e5.cancelFarmStop();e1031("Landing finished. You have control again.");return end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 e1045.y=e1045.position.Y
 pcall(function()
  e1045.root.Anchored=false
  e1045.root.CFrame=CFrame.new(e1045.position)*e1045.root.CFrame.Rotation
  e1045.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  e1045.character:SetAttribute("Teleporting",e1045.y)
 end)
end))
